Voter Action Project
CNN: Trump is dismantling election security networks. State officials are alarmed
Team,
The United States has a history of strong preparation and quick work by an information-sharing and analysis network of hundreds of federal, state, and local election, cybersecurity, and law enforcement officials to protect our elections. It's a history we should be proud of.
But now key parts of this security network, much of it built over the past decade, are being systematically dismantled by the Trump administration and Elon Musk’s Department of Government Efficiency, a CNN investigation has found – leaving election offices across the country scrambling to protect against future threats.
In an age of cyber attacks, poorly funded election equipment breaking down, or anti-voting activists trying to skew the results, these moves to remove the guardrails on our elections are a dangerous step away from democracy.
That's why our work is so critical. We need to get the word out about these threats to voting rights -- all while we work to register new voters, activate registered voters, and fight suppressive laws to make sure every vote counts.

Friend, we aren’t a swing state anymore. __We’re a Republican stronghold.__
---
[](http://links.freedom.rondesantis.com/s/c/P7EZEAwD-RdJxn8SruESy_3TwwInO7JqSbz1lWXDgRQFYm__O828dM7uA0vH7rlD48qw2PEXLn62Kl1_S9DUUbJM6XPk6SPTHkcuQ2OIWYhFzftVcKYCHUCxSyJXf11lRvoTSxuS8Nb24wGVgoHPl1HV-HITtW1XOIjqM8GkWTBytHXRQEG11Bx-qH2rm13fd3X9x2Gw8IscJiwRo7OCf-5XEoG7ykl2j46fCW_pcdSMn4_4P4Hv5JEPXznrXO92KEc4ncn13xrnXmZ33F2dWy2PYpKxJ01SvYAHllMiV_ZtTv07fIiNYRaNHMgltcGhx9G4pCgqikIvSew-tYZ_bKmIbLuOm3rlO6kgiz7T5fnl9Cjw7x9R7G5Dxivq_ed9SIxCYE5iKeWWuUz-f5mhItbM2fStfdfz/ncEEwfEN1Dt8sujLt4D7FpNkYCmzipuP/7)

But that introduces a new problem...

**Since you now need an “R” by your name to get elected statewide and in most parts of Florida, the issue will be squishy politicians and even outright liberals running as “Republicans” but, once elected, following their true beliefs and governing to the left.**

**We are already seeing this and it will only get worse as the Democrat party continues to crater.**
---
[**TELL THEM YOU WON’T BE TRICKED**](http://links.freedom.rondesantis.com/s/c/s53jEcUthDg7boZJ8OaR0NDF3JkRjFYZmUyhH58zEmzQ8rNKAH_YWnHkdSoQ3qp1rVi8ePgdzaXfGTskU7MWu2Y_VuoUPqqPbJcLiuxxyPOrYZOILoV_AUpPxR1AdmQDjq3qoEIbpTofSzIWNv7mFIz8HGG-X1z3c__g9gIsqi-po5alCjaKm8N4qTaTI3fDkN5lEGihL0YHpQZMBmnI4GiokMXojbBlQIeJbpA7sVwznBD3SvRjFMbXdKHp2REWhCVPQf1wslIywKJ6nSG3E9KtGE0PiMFTnA0bWTWgrFHCp6ew9IHTHdzIrxNN1GNqq6apiv6B41T4V-HCLD4p_se71NWYnuanBzvv-6CKX6szmk299nIahi8bTSLq_L88dD9Pu2NSn86TaFA3bWD9uyHNxBLixxs7/TNn2yAOBv9T4z_O00VbUFeZsIdk5eEoK/7)

name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: Making clear what’s on the line / Enfatizando lo que está en juego
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
Fighting in D.C. and Texas against federal healthcare budget cuts
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%20at%20Capitol%20-%20Medicaid%20action.JPG]
TOP ON THE MOVE: Dallas staff members Amanda Juarez and Chris Sanders along with member Larry D. Smith this week joined forces with national allies Community Change at the U.S. Capitol, to urge more members of Congress to vote NO on any legislative budget proposal that cuts funds to Medicaid and SNAP.
Congressional Republicans want over $2.3 TRILLION in cuts to Medicaid — cuts that will devastate working families, children, seniors, and people with disabilities. The House has yet to take up a vote on the federal budget, so there's still time to call out these reckless cuts and spread the word about how they will harm Texans of all walks of life.
TAKE ACTION:
1. Fill out this quick form to contact your member of Congress [https://everytexan.salsalabs.org/ProtectMedicaidandSNAPNow/index.html] and send them an email demanding they oppose these drastic cuts.
2. Join TOP and Texas healthcare advocates MONDAY, APRIL 14 at 6:30 p.m. at Friendship-West Baptist Church in Dallas for a community event where you can receive detailed information on these proposed healthcare budget cuts, as well as how you can plug in to fight back with us! Download and share the event flyer. [https://organizetexas.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/protect-medicaidsnap-april-14th-1.jpg]
Contact Tiffany at thogue@organizetexas.org [thogue@organizetexas.org] to learn more about Monday's event.
ACT NOW:
Keep up the pressure against bad bail bills in our legislature
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Make%20calls%20image.png]
Bad right-wing bills attacking bail reform and our constitutional rights continue to make their way through the legislative process at the Texas Capitol, meaning we have to step up our fight against them. That starts with applying pressure online and on the phones to stop legislation SJR1 and its House companion HJR16 [https://www.houstonpublicmedia.org/articles/news/politics/immigration/2025/02/12/513730/two-texas-senate-bills-would-deny-people-without-legal-status-bail-if-charged-a-felony/] .
What you can do:
1. LIKE and SHARE TOP’s Facebook post [https://www.facebook.com/OrganizeTexas/posts/pfbid0BzEjthvjTecYKrTEy3HwiJogdJQgE1TP7onWAw2uE18rwAUJ34SGMNdytakdhNMZl] calling out SJR1 and HJR16.
2. Use the script in the Facebook post to call and urge your Texas state representative to OPPOSE both SJR1 and HJR16 ( find out who your state rep. is here [https://wrm.capitol.texas.gov/home] ).
Email Laquita at lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] to find out how you can plug into our fight against these and other dangerous right-wing bills in our state legislature.
Remembering a former TOP board member and tenacious community leader
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/FINAL%20-%20Rev.%20Connely%20farewell%20graphic.png]
The TOP community is saddened to hear of the passing of a longtime community champion and early board member of our organization, Rev. Robert Eugene Conley.
Born and raised in Dallas, Rev. Conley's faith guided his work to improve living conditions for his fellow West Dallas neighbors. He also was passionate about youth sports, helping develop and coach little-league football teams to benefit the West Dallas community. Rev. Conley founded and was pastor at Testament of Praise Church in Dallas.
He proudly served as a member of TOP's Board of Directors, where he led as chairperson for our Irving and Grand Prairie chapters at the time. His vibrant, positive spirit at organization meetings and community events will be fondly remembered. We extend our heartfelt condolences to his family and loved ones. Rest in power, Rev. Conley!
TOP Tip: Utilize this easy access clinic in Dallas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Afiya%20Center%20-%20Easy%20Access%20Clinic%20flyer%20graphic.png]
Healthcare should not only be affordable, but accessible. A quick health check-up can sometimes be a lifesaver. Our friends at the Afiya Center in Dallas host a free easy access clinic every third Saturday of the month. Click here for their flyer with more details. [https://organizetexas.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/Afiya-Center-Easy-Access-Clinic-flyer.pdf]
Español
Lucha en Washington D.C. y Texas contra los recortes al presupuesto federal de salud
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%20at%20Capitol%20-%20Medicaid%20action.JPG]
TOP EN ACCIÓN: Amanda Juárez y Chris Sanders, miembros del personal de Dallas, junto con el miembro Larry D. Smith, unieron fuerzas esta semana con sus aliados nacionales Community Change en el Capitolio de los Estados Unidos para empujar a más congresistas a votar NO a cualquier propuesta presupuestaria legislativa que recorte fondos a Medicaid y SNAP.
Los republicanos del Congreso quieren más de $2.3 billones en recortes a Medicaid, recortes que devastarán a las familias trabajadoras, los niños, las personas mayores y las personas con discapacidad. La Cámara de Representantes aún no ha votado el presupuesto federal, por lo que aún hay tiempo para denunciar estos recortes imprudentes y difundir cómo perjudicarán a los texanos de todos niveles y estilos de vida.
ACTÚA:
1. Completa este breve formulario para contactar a tu congresista [https://everytexan.salsalabs.org/ProtectMedicaidandSNAPNow/index.html] y envíale un correo electrónico exigiéndole que se oponga a estos drásticos recortes.
2. Únete a TOP y a los defensores de la salud de Texas el LUNES 14 DE ABRIL a las 6:30 p. m. En la Iglesia Bautista Friendship-West de Dallas , asistirán a un evento comunitario donde recibirán información detallada sobre los recortes propuestos al presupuesto de salud, ¡y cómo pueden unirse a nosotros para luchar! Descargue y comparta el flyer del evento. [https://organizetexas.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/protect-medicaidsnap-april-14th-1.jpg]
Para más información sobre el evento del lunes, contacten a Tiffany en thogue@organizetexas.org [thogue@organizetexas.org] .
ACTÚE AHORA:
Mantenga la presión contra los proyectos de ley de fianzas deficientes en nuestra legislatura
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Make%20calls%20image.png]
Los proyectos de ley de derecha que atacan la reforma de fianzas y nuestros derechos constitucionales siguen avanzando en el proceso legislativo del Capitolio de Texas, lo que significa que debemos intensificar nuestra lucha contra ellos. Esto comienza con la presión en línea y por teléfono para detener la legislación SJR1 y su equivalente en la Cámara de Representantes, la HJR16 [http://www.houstonpublicmedia.org/articles/news/politics/immigration/2025/02/12/513730/two-texas-senate-bills-would-deny-people-without-legal-status-bail-if-charged-a-felony/] .
Qué puedes hacer:
1. Dale un "Like" y COMPARTE la publicación de Facebook de TOP [https://www.facebook.com/OrganizeTexas/posts/pfbid0BzEjthvjTecYKrTEy3HwiJogdJQgE1TP7onWAw2uE18rwAUJ34SGMNdytakdhNMZl] que critica la SJR1 y la HJR16.
2. Usa el guion de la publicación de Facebook para llamar e instar a tu representante estatal de Texas a OPONERSE a la SJR1 y la HJR16 ( descubre quién es tu representante estatal aquí [https://wrm.capitol.texas.gov/home] ).
Envía un correo electrónico a Laquita a lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] para saber cómo puedes unirte a nuestra lucha contra estos y otros proyectos de ley de derecha peligrosos en nuestra legislatura estatal.
Recordando a un ex miembro de la junta directiva de TOP y un tenaz líder comunitario
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/FINAL%20-%20Rev.%20Connely%20farewell%20graphic.png]
La comunidad de TOP lamenta profundamente la pérdida de un veterano defensor de la comunidad y uno de los primeros miembros de la junta directiva de nuestra organización, el reverendo Robert Eugene Conley.
Nacido y criado en Dallas, la fe del reverendo Conley guió su trabajo para mejorar las condiciones de vida de sus vecinos del oeste de Dallas. También era un apasionado de los deportes juveniles, ayudando a desarrollar y entrenar equipos de fútbol americano de ligas menores para beneficio de la comunidad del oeste de Dallas. El reverendo Conley fundó y fue pastor de la Iglesia Testamento de Alabanza en Dallas.
Se desempeñó con orgullo como miembro de la Junta Directiva de TOP, donde fue presidente de nuestros capítulos de Irving y Grand Prairie en ese momento. Su espíritu vibrante y positivo en las reuniones de la organización y los eventos comunitarios será recordado con cariño. Extendemos nuestras más sinceras condolencias a su familia y seres queridos. ¡Descanse en paz, reverendo Conley!
Consejos de TOP: Utilice esta clínica de salud gratuita en Dallas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Afiya%20Center%20-%20Easy%20Access%20Clinic%20flyer%20graphic.png]
La atención médica no solo debe ser asequible, sino también accesible. Un chequeo médico rápido a veces puede salvarte la vida. Nuestros amigos del Centro Afiya en Dallas ofrecen una clínica gratuita de fácil acceso cada tercer sábado del mes. Haz clic aquí para ver su folleto y más detalles. [https://organizetexas.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/Afiya-Center-Easy-Access-Clinic-flyer.pdf]

subject: The Mountain Minute: 4/10/2025
body:
New council, new direction: Grand Junction voters back reform candidates
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._hqNA/sbu06a8d5ad)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._hqNA/s0tc52f9e6e)**
| | Hi everyone,
Listen to today's **Mountain Minute Podcast** [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._hqNA/s0g995931d7), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._hqNA/s9h9a945ca4) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._hqNA/scgac78c3de)! Here is a summary of today's top stories:
**🏛️ Colorado Legislative Session Updates...** Lawmakers are advancing HB1312, which lets courts weigh “misgendering” in [custody cases](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._hqNA/s2pff6205ee)—drawing rare Democratic opposition from [Rep. Bob Marshall](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._hqNA/scvf7e931ce). Meanwhile, HB25-1027 aims to sidestep potential policies under RFK Jr. for school [immunization rules](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._hqNA/s4n5f434432).
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Grand Junction voters just [flipped the city council](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._hqNA/s2h4760e5a9), electing a slate of reform candidates focused on transparency, public safety, and resisting state overreach. Meanwhile, Boebert’s [gray wolf delisting bill](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._hqNA/sai2f377aae) passed a key House committee, with rural leaders saying the measure is critical to protect livestock, energy production, and local economies.
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** Wall Street rallied after President Trump paused some tariff hikes and foreign demand surged in a [$39B Treasury auction](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._hqNA/s2g3b7a77a8)—defying critics who warned his trade agenda would sink investor confidence.
🗣️ **Commentary Spotlight...** Mesa County Commissioner Bobbie Daniel calls on Governor Polis to [veto SB25-003](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._hqNA/s7oc34c4651), warning the bill's extreme gun control provisions betray Colorado’s liberty-loving roots and treat law-abiding citizens like criminals.
This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, April 10, 2025.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[New council, new direction: Grand Junction voters back reform candidates](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._hqNA/s3m10ba1ef4)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._hqNA/saqfae135cd)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._hqNA/s7n5779248d)
All four City Council seats up for election in Grand Junction this April have been claimed by candidates promising a new direction for the city. While official results won’t be certified until later this month, the margins are clear—and the message from voters, even clearer.
Cody Kennedy, Robert Ballard and Ben Van Dyke each secured a win in their contested council races. Laurel Cole, who ran unopposed in District A, rounds out the incoming group. The results point to strong voter support for candidates focused on transparency, public safety and responsiveness to residents.
“Let’s take Grand Junction back,” Van Dyke told supporters during his victory speech at the election night watch party at Blue Moon Bar & Grill.
Cole followed with a smile. “I don’t think we need to take it back. We took it back.”

body:
The GOP overturned a Biden-era CFPB rule to limit bank overdraft fees to $5.
# [](https://act.robbonta.com/go/3?refcode=em20250410&t=1&akid=1732%2E1088799%2E-PF4Sq)
$200 million — that’s how much money Californians lost to bank overdraft fees in 2022.
High overdraft fees serve no purpose other than to help the rich get richer, while disproportionately hurting working-class families and people of color across California and the nation. That’s why last year, the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) and the Biden Administration capped overdraft fees at $5, which would save Americans _billions of dollars each year._
**But the Republican-controlled Congress just overturned this rule as part of their broader fight to destroy the CFPB, opening the door for big banks to once again charge an average $35 per overdraft and prey on working-class Californians.**
We’re profoundly disappointed. Big banks don’t need the extra $7.7 billion they’ll get due to this ruling – _families like yours do._
**[Ending this overdraft rule will hurt Californians, but AG Bonta is determined not to let Republicans and big corporations drag us backward without a fight. Chip in $5 to support Rob’s work to protect us from predatory fees!](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-20250410?refcode=em20250410-1732&amount=5&refcode2=1732_1088799_-PF4Sq&akid=1732%2E1088799%2E-PF4Sq)**
**Rob has already taken numerous actions to defend consumer protections from being ripped to shreds by right-wing officials and greedy corporations:**
* Last month, he filed amicus briefs challenging the Trump administration’s efforts to dismantle the CFPB, arguing that the shuttering of the agency would cause catastrophic and irreparable harm to consumers nationwide.

* In April 2024, he supported a rule to close a regulatory loophole that banks use to charge overdraft fees without properly informing customers of the terms.

* In February 2024, he warned smaller banks and credit unions that overdraft fees disproportionately penalize low-income consumers and consumers of color, and may violate consumer protection laws.

In the face of an unstable economy and stagnating wages under President Trump, our families need every dollar they earn to afford essentials like rent, groceries, and school supplies for their children. Rob knows that, which is why he’s defending the CFPB and other consumer protections with everything he’s got.
**[Make a grassroots contribution to our people-powered campaign to keep the Attorney General in office fighting for working families in California and across the county.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-20250410?refcode=em20250410-1732&amount=5&refcode2=1732_1088799_-PF4Sq&akid=1732%2E1088799%2E-PF4Sq)**

This includes proposing an amendment to a House budget resolution to safeguard Medicaid from significant funding reductions. 2️⃣ Advocating for a Farm Bill that supports agricultural production and development. 3️⃣ Working on the Agriculture Committee to demand common-sense responses to the bird flu and the impact it’s having on our farmers and consumers alike. These are real actions that help real people, friends. But they were only possible because we won — and by the narrowest margin. | | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zj68j5jsim0an1936gnmjta672t9k7f98bbeqieg_rp22sh2s8i6eob1cphmaor5c3h2bs)
---
Co-Pilot -
**_Our mission to defend Michigan has a_**** _major development. _**
I’m announcing **my intention to run for Governor at one of the most critical points in our nation’s history.**
Under Joe Biden and Gretchen Whitmer, our economy, our industry, and our people have all suffered.
Michiganders were fed up with the status-quo bureaucracy, and that’s why our state turned **RED** in 2024.
I stood alongside President Trump on the campaign trail and spoke with him at rallies where we shared our vision for America.
Our movement for strong, America First policies has gained momentum, and we need to carry it through to the midterms to ensure that Michigan can get back on track.
---
|
---
_**_Our Mission_**_ The first step towards fixing our state and our nation occurred on November 5th of last year when we elected President Trump, but the truth is, we still have work to do. We have 2 more years of Democrat obstruction and failed economic policies to endure in Michigan. That’s why it’s of vital importance to prepare NOW. **Our mission is twofold:**
---
1\. We are working **_to make life easier and more prosperous for Michiganders_** \- no matter what political party they are in - through pro-business, pro-growth and **PRO-WORKER** America First policies. 2\. We are working to **PREVENT** another 4 years of the same socialist policies that have hurt our state. **Neither of these objectives can be completed alone. That’s why I’ll need your support.** But, before I ask you to join us, I want you to know my story.
---
|
---
_**_My Story_**_ You’re going to hear a lot about me from the mainstream media over the coming months. I’m ready for the mud-slinging from the Democrat establishment, but I want to tell you who I am: \- First and foremost, I am a **God-Loving husband and father of three boys**.
\- I am a **West Point graduate and a combat veteran** who commanded 2 Apache Helicopter platoons – logging over 750 flight hours to protect our freedom and defend the American Dream. ** \- I am the proud **son of two parents who were born and raised in the Jim Crow South**. They moved to Michigan, built a business, and watched as their son was sworn into the U.S. House of Representatives.
**\- I am a businessman** with a background in the automotive and manufacturing sector. I**** understand how our economy works, how red tape and bureaucracy weighs down innovation and progress, and the tremendous responsibility that comes with being a job creator.
\- I am a **public servant who represents the people of Michigan’s 10th Congressional District** and fights for them every day in Washington, DC.
\- I am a**conservative warrior who has gone toe-to-toe with the Democrat establishment** **machine** time and time again.
I am **prepared to lead our mission** to make Michigan the best place to live in the nation once more. But don’t let anyone tell you that this is going to be easy.
---
[**JOIN OUR MISSION**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z7o5048a7qc5mh20j2sfqhisur56vtnnn3bt55j0_rp22sh2s8i6eob1cphmaor5c3h2bs)
---
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z4lgli00hpnilgi0suibm60moui64a49nr2m0hp0_rp22sh2s8i6eob1cphmaor5c3h2bs)
---
|
---
_**_The Road Ahead_**_ \- Michigan will be the **most competitive swing state in the nation**. With open Gubernatorial and Senate seats on the ballot, all eyes will be laser focused on our campaign.
\- Democrats have controlled Lansing for over 6 years now. Their **political and financial machine is entrenched** and ready to attack any person who tries to challenge them.
**\- Midterms are notoriously difficult for the party in power nationally**. We are going to have to work twice as hard to share our message of economic prosperity and America First policies.
\- This race will be on the **top of the list for every single Democrat Dark money SuperPAC**.
For all of those reasons, this fight cannot be won alone.
---
|
---
__**Why I Need You On My Team**__ I need the support of patriots like you to have a chance to win this battle. I know the challenges ahead and I’m choosing to fight anyway. **_[**_Now that you know the stakes, are you willing to continue on this mission with me as my Co-Pilot? _**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2znph4740vf94bj8488840c30kr6vbhh8peu6at10_rp22sh2s8i6eob1cphmaor5c3h2bs)_** **If you’re in, I humbly ask that you sign your name to become a founding supporter of my race.**
---
[**BECOME MY FOUNDING CO-PILOT**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zmdoffos4l5lrp61mf99g9rekue4n88negdq3tq0_rp22sh2s8i6eob1cphmaor5c3h2bs)
---

And we’re certainly not bought and paid for by George Soros or any of his dark money groups like the Tides Foundation.Our funding comes from grassroots conservatives like you who care deeply about the future of America.We answer to you -- not to George and Alex Soros. With that said, if you’re able to make a larger emergency gift of $50, $75, $100, $150, $250, $500, or even $1,000 -- please do it.**[We have a lot of work to do to STOP SOROS and time is not on our side.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zc218iuh4ct2rgspk063l2uto7ao0ta7mrvicdu8_rp22sh2s8i6eob1cphmapr4c3h2bs) **Thank you for joining us in this fight for America.

name: John James
subject: Our New Mission.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by John James for MI 8050 Wolfson Lane, Grand Blanc, MI 48439
body:
I’m announcing my intention to run for Governor at one of the most critical points in our nation’s history.

| | | [](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z4ft6b8b8cceul5f9v41up4fq18s36pvjce12gmg_rp22sh2s8i6eob1cphm6pb6c1h2bs)
---
Co-Pilot -
**_Our mission to defend Michigan has a_**** _major development. _**
I’m announcing **my intention to run for Governor at one of the most critical points in our nation’s history.**
Under Joe Biden and Gretchen Whitmer, our economy, our industry, and our people have all suffered.
Michiganders were fed up with the status-quo bureaucracy, and that’s why our state turned **RED** in 2024.
I stood alongside President Trump on the campaign trail and spoke with him at rallies where we shared our vision for America.
Our movement for strong, America First policies has gained momentum, and we need to carry it through to the midterms to ensure that Michigan can get back on track.
---
|
---
_**_Our Mission_**_ The first step towards fixing our state and our nation occurred on November 5th of last year when we elected President Trump, but the truth is, we still have work to do. We have 2 more years of Democrat obstruction and failed economic policies to endure in Michigan. That’s why it’s of vital importance to prepare NOW. **Our mission is twofold:**
---
1\. We are working **_to make life easier and more prosperous for Michiganders_** \- no matter what political party they are in - through pro-business, pro-growth and **PRO-WORKER** America First policies. 2\. We are working to **PREVENT** another 4 years of the same socialist policies that have hurt our state. **Neither of these objectives can be completed alone. That’s why I’ll need your support.** But, before I ask you to join us, I want you to know my story.
---
|
---
_**_My Story_**_ You’re going to hear a lot about me from the mainstream media over the coming months. I’m ready for the mud-slinging from the Democrat establishment, but I want to tell you who I am: \- First and foremost, I am a **God-Loving husband and father of three boys**.
\- I am a **West Point graduate and a combat veteran** who commanded 2 Apache Helicopter platoons – logging over 750 flight hours to protect our freedom and defend the American Dream. ** \- I am the proud **son of two parents who were born and raised in the Jim Crow South**. They moved to Michigan, built a business, and watched as their son was sworn into the U.S. House of Representatives.
**\- I am a businessman** with a background in the automotive and manufacturing sector. I**** understand how our economy works, how red tape and bureaucracy weighs down innovation and progress, and the tremendous responsibility that comes with being a job creator.
\- I am a **public servant who represents the people of Michigan’s 10th Congressional District** and fights for them every day in Washington, DC.
\- I am a**conservative warrior who has gone toe-to-toe with the Democrat establishment** **machine** time and time again.
I am **prepared to lead our mission** to make Michigan the best place to live in the nation once more. But don’t let anyone tell you that this is going to be easy.
---
[**JOIN OUR MISSION**](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zd58cneo1d86qln3bishin48tvc7vqqht6bj4dd8_rp22sh2s8i6eob1cphm6pb6c1h2bs)
---
[](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zn7ma6bkpcneimsj5m4j3u3chdlfp6u82i5ntulo_rp22sh2s8i6eob1cphm6pb6c1h2bs)
---
|
---
_**_The Road Ahead_**_ \- Michigan will be the **most competitive swing state in the nation**. With open Gubernatorial and Senate seats on the ballot, all eyes will be laser focused on our campaign.
\- Democrats have controlled Lansing for over 6 years now. Their **political and financial machine is entrenched** and ready to attack any person who tries to challenge them.
**\- Midterms are notoriously difficult for the party in power nationally**. We are going to have to work twice as hard to share our message of economic prosperity and America First policies.
\- This race will be on the **top of the list for every single Democrat Dark money SuperPAC**.
For all of those reasons, this fight cannot be won alone.
---
|
---
__**Why I Need You On My Team**__ I need the support of patriots like you to have a chance to win this battle. I know the challenges ahead and I’m choosing to fight anyway. **_[**_Now that you know the stakes, are you willing to continue on this mission with me as my Co-Pilot? _**](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zqmi57a7lch9bnfcihet38e4qcr4rbmt6kqvpsao_rp22sh2s8i6eob1cphm6pb6c1h2bs)_** **If you’re in, I humbly ask that you sign your name to become a founding supporter of my race.**
---
[**BECOME MY FOUNDING CO-PILOT**](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zm40bt3rk3v8i9in8sglpl1v5sepfa4jpblsctmo_rp22sh2s8i6eob1cphm6pb6c1h2bs)
---
[**SUPPORT JOHN JAMES**](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z6thu35ou598djum3karulqa20sjc3fkru9j7a7o_rp22sh2s8i6eob1cphm6pb6c1h2bs)
---
Let’s Fly! John James

name: Rep. Brandon Gill
subject: I’m taking on China because nobody else is
body:
My plan to take on China

| | | | |
---
Friend, the most recent estimate tells us that **277,336 acres of US farmland** are owned by individuals and groups _linked to the_ _**Chinese Communist Party (CCP)**_.__
Of which**277k acres** are adjacent to our _**US Military bases**_ and other sensitive US sites.
**I don’t just want to investigate why the Chinese Communist Party is buying up as much of our land as they can:****_I want to make it illegal_****.**
**That’s why******I** introduced hard-hitting legislation in Congress that would ban China from buying up American agricultural land.**
[TAKE OUR LAND BACK FROM CHINA](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aiYt/?__vbtrk=Mjg0NTgxOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjg0NTgxOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
Why aren’t other Members of Congress fighting back against the Chinese?
It’s because China’s influence in American politics runs DEEP and spans further than most people realize.
There are too many on Capitol Hill who refuse to take a stand against this looming threat due to being **_compromised_** or being** _too afraid._**
We know for a fact that **there are hundreds of groups tied directly to the CCP** working around the clock to get **as much of their money into the hands of American politicians as possible – and we know that sometimes ****_it works:_**
[](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aiYt/?__vbtrk=Mjg0NTgxOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjg0NTgxOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
We know that, right now, there are **American politicians** walking around who benefitted from a **$1,000,000 CCP fund that only existed to influence them:**
[](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aiYt/?__vbtrk=Mjg0NTgxOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjg0NTgxOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
[TAKE OUR LAND BACK FROM CHINA](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aiYt/?__vbtrk=Mjg0NTgxOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjg0NTgxOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
| | Friend, I’m not just challenging the CCP.
_I’m putting them on notice:_**___I can’t be bought. I won’t be scared away._**
**I am going to root out the Chinese Communist Party operatives who are buying up our farmland**** _and take every inch of our land back from them_.**
The CCP has **hundreds of millions of dollars at their disposal,** and they’re ready to mobilize it against any American who dares to challenge their interests.
I knew when I started this fight that I would start seeing large volumes of dark money moving against me.
And I knew the attacks were going to intensify. No matter what they throw at me, I will never back down from a fight to guarantee our nation’s security. But **I desperately need resources to hit back hard** and I’m struggling to keep up right now.
I’m calling on patriots like you to stand with me so I can fend off these attacks against me from the CCP’s puppets in Washington.
**So I’m asking, if you don’t want to see me pushed out of Congress by the influence of foreign adversaries who are snatching up space vital to our national security,** **_[_please chip in whatever you can afford TODAY to keep me in this fight_](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aiYt/?__vbtrk=Mjg0NTgxOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjg0NTgxOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_.**
Let’s take our country back once and for all!
---
_With Strength,_
[](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aiYt/?__vbtrk=Mjg0NTgxOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjg0NTgxOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
**Congressman Brandon Gill**
[](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/aiYt/?__vbtrk=Mjg0NTgxOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjg0NTgxOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
**P.S.** No matter what comes of this, I want you to know, I will **never** back down from a fight with the Chinese Communist Party – bring it on.

**Good Morning!** On this day in 1970, Apollo 13 was launched with astronauts James A. Lovell, John L. Swigert, and Fred W. Haise. An oxygen tank explosion aborted the mission, prompting improvised efforts by the crew and NASA that ultimately brought the astronauts safely back to Earth. [See the launch here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0zzGO6jAQANDT2B3RzHiwSeEC8ZUO2l9GDp4QIwejxGGV2692-73Ak97_a38NKafX4xZm8XUsPQEdD8AHxD6GlPeedfSjCInR4tExG2vJGT15ABxiC-yodcGcXBtOgdowArb2DnTXyf9owIgIiOAaa3lgYXQUThj5qBgkplqW5lnSq04y5r18ZGnuZdbZT7W-V2XOijpF3V62ujWDKOrcxdzOT35eBlCmGyXUbRFl_q1TWCTqxcf3V8o5rdYphsccUv4l61_Fj6fvAAAA__8wQVCA). ## 6 Killed in Lower Manhattan Helicopter Crash
All six people aboard a tourist helicopter, including three children, were killed when it [crashed into the Hudson River near Lower Manhattan](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFuwyAQQL8Gb1jcgbEzMFSqvKVLVXW0sDnH1xITAU3kv6_SvfOTnp7e53k6e468X978lVxd04QKO6mMBJiC53hMpgluJULSDTnojdHWYq-bzQ2WsBtmtKhI6075Ofg1DCfUQQewvmH3tCkDAApA9a21ZjZkoEc_QDCdMIoC15Tbr8R73WiNR7pTbpd0baLbar0VoV8EjgJHPy87PUp7SU8scPx4FzhuFHlJt0pZLtmXjYrcfkJJu8x8pyx3esgj5W-5cD0EjqWmfAg9chD6FVDZE5z6rsku3B4cIxfbC6MuV8_xr6L-d-Xu8DcAAP__XHJjGA) late Thursday afternoon. The helicopter, a Bell 206 operated by New York Helicopter Tours, was found upside down in the river. The cause is still under investigation, but [aviation experts say](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00L1uwyAUxfGnwRsWHxeTDAyVKm_p2tHCcAlU2FiGxPXbV8ne-SedI_2_b9PNppzW-5dd0LRQJsGEogwo55O3KZ8TdN4ERIGyQ8M1gBwGoWUXDegZryFcLMB1vjqrmRxUUMqrQXoFrEvmtcaAc844Z7ofBpgBgWthL9yDIsDQp1b2_qektUUM-SxP3HtXli6b2NpWifwgYiRiPI6jD-VXreeLiRhXPCoRYywHjZiTK1vDnbrd1oiexoevZaVzth4rXexJo30idWVBWkIgcny0ZarlsTsk8tNF2-5bez_vxm9HyjnVQRNg98Wm_Ib2X6KnEX8BAAD__2B_aiY) a catastrophic rotor failure may have caused it to break apart mid-air. The victims were a tourist family from Spain who had been in the air for about 15 minutes before the helicopter went down. The House passed the Republican-led [SAVE Act in a 220-208 vote](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL1uhDAQhJ_GdEa2WX6ucHHJiVSXJkVKZGCBjQx2bN8h8vQR6VPNJ400Gn2f9-5uyNI2v5sVdZpcp4QquQAuZTcaskcH2agnRIVFhlrWAEVVqbrIFt0DDNDIS3NpStGYpuxVhX0Jysgepxoz0ueaACmlkFLUeVVBDwiyVqaRI5QMBI6UXMi_HG1pwcke7okhH9yaWb2k5CMrrky1TLX7vudr3M6OqRY3_ohMtRvuZ3hnKdFw4uIeEbk3MWLks_O8J2t5wO8HBdpm7oNzE3cTHyjRD25xIc-T4wFnignDyU-XkKnWBH69yte343awonUDjay4vZy6cI8fGHwW9Oh3spZiVTMQ82rI_r1P_9l8avUbAAD__3IGeMA), requiring people to present proof of U.S. citizenship--such as a passport or birth certificate--to register to vote in federal elections. Four Democrats joined Republicans in supporting the bill, which also mandates that states remove Illegal immigrants from voter rolls and allows citizens to sue officials who don't enforce the requirements. Supporters argue it protects election integrity, while critics say it could disenfranchise millions of eligible voters. Co-Pilot -
**_Our mission to defend Michigan has a_**** _major development. _**
I’m announcing **my intention to run for Governor at one of the most critical points in our nation’s history.**
Under Joe Biden and Gretchen Whitmer, our economy, our industry, and our people have all suffered.
Michiganders were fed up with the status-quo bureaucracy, and that’s why our state turned **RED** in 2024.
I stood alongside President Trump on the campaign trail and spoke with him at rallies where we shared our vision for America.
Our movement for strong, America First policies has gained momentum, and we need to carry it through to the midterms to ensure that Michigan can get back on track.
---
|
---
_**_Our Mission_**_ The first step towards fixing our state and our nation occurred on November 5th of last year when we elected President Trump, but the truth is, we still have work to do. We have 2 more years of Democrat obstruction and failed economic policies to endure in Michigan. That’s why it’s of vital importance to prepare NOW. **Our mission is twofold:**
---
1\. We are working **_to make life easier and more prosperous for Michiganders_** \- no matter what political party they are in - through pro-business, pro-growth and **PRO-WORKER** America First policies. 2\. We are working to **PREVENT** another 4 years of the same socialist policies that have hurt our state. **Neither of these objectives can be completed alone. That’s why I’ll need your support.** But, before I ask you to join us, I want you to know my story.
---
|
---
_**_My Story_**_ You’re going to hear a lot about me from the mainstream media over the coming months. I’m ready for the mud-slinging from the Democrat establishment, but I want to tell you who I am: \- First and foremost, I am a **God-Loving husband and father of three boys**.
\- I am a **West Point graduate and a combat veteran** who commanded 2 Apache Helicopter platoons – logging over 750 flight hours to protect our freedom and defend the American Dream. \- I am the proud **son of two parents who were born and raised in the Jim Crow South**. They moved to Michigan, built a business, and watched as their son was sworn into the U.S. House of Representatives.
**\- I am a businessman** with a background in the automotive and manufacturing sector. I**** understand how our economy works, how red tape and bureaucracy weighs down innovation and progress, and the tremendous responsibility that comes with being a job creator.
\- I am a **public servant who represents the people of Michigan’s 10th Congressional District** and fights for them every day in Washington, DC.
\- I am a**conservative warrior who has gone toe-to-toe with the Democrat establishment** **machine** time and time again.
I am **prepared to lead our mission** to make Michigan the best place to live in the nation once more. But don’t let anyone tell you that this is going to be easy.
---

I stood alongside President Trump on the campaign trail and spoke with him at rallies where we shared our vision for America. Our movement for strong, America First policies has gained momentum, and we need to carry it through to the midterms to ensure that Michigan can get back on track. | Our Mission The first step towards fixing our state and our nation occurred on November 5th of last year when we elected President Trump, but the truth is, we still have work to do. name: History Facts
subject: This president's son was the oldest D-Day soldier

More than 130,000 Allied troops landed at Normandy as part of D-Day, but only one of them was the son of a former U.S. president: Theodore Roosevelt Jr.

# [Teddy Roosevelt's son was the oldest soldier to fight on D-Day.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=suju5q&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Famous Figures](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=suju5q&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=suju5q&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| M ore than 130,000 Allied troops landed at Normandy as part of D-Day, but only one of them was the son of a former U.S. president: [Theodore Roosevelt Jr.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=suju5q&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), who also held the distinction of being the oldest soldier to deploy. He was born on September 13, 1887, making the brigadier general 56 years old when he asked to land with the first wave. After two verbal requests were denied, Roosevelt submitted a written petition, in which he [wrote](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=suju5q&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), “I personally know both officers and men of these advance units and believe that it will steady them to know that I am with them.”
---
High command finally relented, and Roosevelt landed on Utah Beach equipped with his walking cane and service pistol on June 6, 1944. Later, soldiers from his unit indeed credited his “calm and humorous demeanor” with helping them push through. Roosevelt was already a decorated veteran at this point, having served with distinction in World War I, but his military career was cut short when he suffered a fatal heart attack barely a month after D-Day. General George Patton hailed him as one of the bravest men he ever knew, and Roosevelt received a posthumous Medal of Honor on September 21, 1944. His son Quentin Roosevelt II stormed Omaha Beach on D-Day, making them the only father-son duo to take part in the Normandy landings.
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=suju5q&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) | [](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=suju5q&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

## The “D” in D-Day doesn’t really stand for anything.
Though you might logically assume it stands for any number of terms, from “deployment” or “disembarkation” to “departure” or “doom,” the “D” in D-Day [doesn’t exactly stand for anything](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=suju5q&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com). The most likely explanation is that the “D” was a redundancy, and simply means “day.” The term dates back to World War I as a placeholder for the start of a military operation, and “H-Hour” was also used to specify the exact time an operation would occur. In addition to keeping such details out of enemy hands, these vague terms allowed some flexibility when planning attacks whose actual start times could change at the last minute.

### MassGOP Calls on Massachusetts Democrats to Demand Rep. Chris Flanagan's Immediate Resignation Following Federal Fraud Arrest
---
---
| Boston, MA\- The Massachusetts Republican Party is calling on the Massachusetts Democratic Party to demand the immediate resignation of State Representative Chris Flanagan, who was arrested this week on federal fraud charges. The charges allege that Flanagan stole tens of thousands of dollars from his former employer to finance his political campaign, pay his mortgage and credit cards, and fund personal expenses including psychic services and high-end menswear.
"This is not the first time the Massachusetts Republican Party has called for Chris Flanagan to resign," said MassGOP Chairwoman Amy Carnevale. "Back in January, when the Office of Campaign and Political Finance found Flanagan responsible for violating campaign finance laws--including fabricating a false alias to intentionally mislead his constituents--we said then that he had no place in public office. The federal charges only confirm what was already evident: Chris Flanagan is unfit to serve, and Massachusetts Democrats must demand his resignation now."
Flanagan's arrest is not an isolated incident--it is part of a disturbing pattern of misconduct within the Massachusetts Democratic Party. In just the past two weeks:

* Boston City Councilor Tania Fernandes Anderson, a Democrat, remains in office despite pleading guilty to multiple counts of fraud.
* A high-ranking MassDems Party operative was recently arrested for unspeakable and deeply disturbing crimes.
* Now, State Representative Chris Flanagan faces federal criminal charges for financial fraud and deception.

"The Massachusetts Democratic Party has a serious problem," continued Carnevale. "This is not about isolated bad actors--it's about a culture of corruption and entitlement that's gone unchecked for far too long. The MassDems must demonstrate they are capable of holding their own accountable, starting with calling for Chris Flanagan's resignation today."
The Massachusetts Republican Party urges Democratic leadership to put the people of Massachusetts first, restore integrity in public service, and take a stand against corruption by demanding Flanagan's immediate removal from office.
###

## Drone Startup Zipline Expands to Texas
San Francisco-based drone delivery startup Zipline [expanded its service to Texas](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyc0DGOqzAQxvHTmA5kT4wdChevoctrt0QTPA6zMhjZFgl7-tVGe4K9wO_T9_-4TTfkyNvjP67k6iuk6Yv3yBv5nDYq-Ik7blSo4jaBhL6VulVq8sjxnHTj3V36QTXklNX6YoaLHprFSdOTATIegr2agBTuCmdzNUFa9AM27H4wqZVSSgLYTqIOIaDt4d5fvZ2FluS5ptzVhSq9sIR4poNyN6e1iW6pdS_i8k_AKGCsNC_dnASMGz2LgPGJccVc298zrafIB-WzLZQPnql9k012fn9yjFyMFVo-VuT4Hqh_aHE4-A4AAP__W91wFg) this week, providing Walmart customers in Mesquite the option to receive their purchases for free within 30 minutes. The P2 Zip fixed-wing drones can transport [up to eight pounds](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyckLGO4yAYhJ8Gd1jwGwe7oLjGXa690sLwk_wnjH3A2ck-_SrZfYKtRpqRRvPNn-t8tRQp3X7bFU19hG3-oD1SQp-3hMX-tbtNWLDaNIOAngvFpZy9pficVePNIvwoGzRSK9Vdxk6Nzd1Ary8KFwQMGsSIWrtuGdy4eAxW49CQeZUJJaWUAkC3wqoQgtU9LP3gtWNKoKe65bbeseLDlhCf24G5ddvaRHOvdS-s-8VgYjCd59mmxflwvmIGU8KzvGRxvOcZy74lX758_g3I34TcY6QD85MXzAc55JT4iuXff6rIYOoGKUWvGExNNn4_KUYqF82UuK2W4ntN_cFxh4HPAAAA___Z_H5B) within a 10-mile radius and can provide "dinner-plate level" accuracy even in rain and wind up to 45 miles per hour. When the autonomous drones have reached their destination, they [hover at an altitude of 300 feet](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyckLGSrCAQRb8GMyxAFA0IXmI2L93QaqUd2UK0oHeY2a_fcmq_YJNOuurce-7HbbqBDz7e_8OOlp7rMX37M_iILh0RM3zCCREzEsRJCdVyobmUkwMfXpOunJ2FG2SFVhqtm25o9FBtdoVeK8DeNIDQd7KVQi-mlfOwdJ10rvL2ggktpZRCKVML0Ou6gmnV3PbOLEwLdJ6OVNOGhE_Ia3gdD0z1cuxVsBvRmVnzj6mRqbGUUi9xXq4nU-PFZmoU-jo9U-NbhjsM_oHpxTNBoq-T_6pyfJ4QXeZ08HcUL542XiDskKjeaA9Vsu4sPgSfO8O0uO_gw7sK_WG1h1U_AQAA__885Hzg) and dispatch a mini-aircraft with a container along a tether to allow package retrieval. Since its beginning in 2016, the $4.2 billion company has completed around 1.5 million deliveries. Initially focused on healthcare supplies, Zipline has expanded to grocery and fast food delivery through partnerships with Chipotle and Sweetgreen. It operates in Japan and several countries in Africa.
## Lawsuit Filed Over Tainted Lottery Drawing
The winner of a $7.5 million Texas Lotto jackpot filed a lawsuit this week against several retailers--including Lottery.com and Lottery Now--that allegedly facilitated a $95 million jackpot win the previous month, claiming he is [owed the winnings from that drawing](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyc0DGO6yAYBODT4A4LMARTULzGXV67pfUHfmKyGCxD4mRPv0qOsP3MN9J8neczxBTz9T-saNszlPknbilm9HvJWOEGG2Ss2CDPgglFmaSczx5ies2y8_bCvOEdWq6lHE5mkKZb7Gi8Zm7QIzsF5SSO3IxKelDcB8O46aJ9Y0xyzjkTQvcMZAgBtBIXNXrtiGToYyt73xZs-IQa0qs8cO9dWbtkl9a2SoZ_RExETMdx9Km0hvvrXuEdIWLKeFQiJk0VXWNKsWT6gegRc8ad1jtW6mKL-Upv4L630mh1C67Y7dZvx7tTT5pIdl0hps9w-8NHDyt-AwAA__9S8Xe4) since it was illegally conducted. Jerry Reed, who purchased his ticket at a grocery store in Mansfield, alleges that four retailers [generated 394,574 tickets](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyckL2O3CAUhZ8Gd9cCjH8oKNK427QprWu4rNnFYBkyHufpoxkpL5DqFOdHR9-vj-UDQwzp8yfuZOrT5-VPOGJI5M6cqOAXHpioUMW0SC574AqEWByGeC-qcWblTouGjBiV6gbdKd1shsjzaZi41Va7teumlQsS2k56mLywtgnmNcaVEEJwKceWo_Le49jLtZ_caJni5ELNZ1s3qvTE4uOdH3S2Nu9NNFutR2HdDyZnJufrutrvJ6aXyeSc6CpMzu_aP4WYa6XzhiPiTSfYiGEvsBFcWMBuhJUc5N8Vsgfdwx5iDDlBSCC57OAL7feRK1whMTk3p3HH9YqUYWSKf-4Y4vta_Q-KDyP_BgAA__9JDoMJ) with some type of winning combination on behalf of an entity called Rook TX, which received $60,264,030 in total prize winnings. The legislature, the Texas Rangers, and Attorney General Ken Paxton [have all investigated](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyc0LFuhDAQBNCvgQ5kL8ZA4SIN3aVNiRa8PhwZG-HNceTro7tPSDfF6I00X7fphj74eP_EjQw_XZp-_R58JHukSBm_ccdImRjjBALaSqhKysmiD9ekSmtmYQdZkpGdUo0eGjWUqwGHYuk7UMOCPfWwDLoVkuS86GZ2A5TevDChpJRSAHS1QOWcw66Fue1ttxRKkPWcjppXYnpiduFKDzrqJW1lMCvznovmo4CxgPE8z3q7MkaMnKJPr1IBY_COMl-BChjxYL-801urQmKm46oCnvnHcwUCtNa6r_d1Lw9j99OH4LPuCiXuG_rwHuZ_fPQw8BcAAP__n6Z3Tw) the scheme. Lt. Gov. Dan Patrick has asserted that "the Lottery has been used as the biggest money laundering scheme in the country." Reed's lawsuit is [not without precedent](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyckMHOnCAUhZ9Gd3cCDMrvgsWkibu_6a5Lc4XrwBTBCOrYp2-cR-jqO8lJvpyc39_DN_rg4_MnzqTLe0rDX78EH8muKVLGFy4YKVPBOAgmGmASOB8s-nAOsrZ6ZLbjNWmupLy33V12tdNCtaJpG4PWcjF-GSPbxrSTslNnDEpee33JmOSccyaEujGU0zShasTYfFllKsnI-pLWW3FU6I15Cmfaab2ZNNdBu1KWXN0flegr0R_HcZtzvLpK9BRhy5XoIx0XPhlBQTNDSKUk-PjghebPkgocPkZawWfIm49PyHhecD7DgmfaCmSXtmDB4U4wEkXgjM3gaCXIcLjz8q_wePAfb7__qldtl8OH4HOrKsmeM_rwmV3-4-Fdi38BAAD__9u4jJE). In 2019, the winner of a 2011 lottery drawing in Iowa settled for $1.5 million after claiming that the head of information technology for the Multi-State Lottery Association orchestrated a previous jackpot.

When Did Criminals Get VIP Status?

| | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/6fe633133a8a/when-we-vote-we-win-14762989?e=8763c56857)
---

| | | | | “If you come here and break our laws, we will hunt you down. Criminals are not welcome in the United States” _**DHS Secretary Kristi Noem**_
---
|
---
| **Opinion | Connecticut’s Sanctuary Delusion: When Did Criminals Get VIP Status?**
---
| | | | | | | | | | [](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=a1767417cb&e=8763c56857)
---
|
---
| **Opinion | Sanctuary Policy**
**Opinion | Connecticut’s Sanctuary Delusion: When Did Criminals Get VIP Status?**
**—By Dominic Rapini, American Businessman and Political Commentator**
Here’s a question for every Connecticut taxpayer to chew on over their morning coffee: When did the rights of illegal immigrants—some of whom have been convicted of serious crimes—become**more important than your right to feel safe walking your kid to school or sitting on your front porch?**
It’s a question our state’s Democratic supermajority seems entirely uninterested in answering. And that should infuriate you.
**Connecticut now ranks fifth in the country for declining ICE detainer requests** —right behind California, Illinois, and other states that seem to think enforcing immigration law is optional. Between 2020 and 2024, **we declined more than 1,150 federal requests to detain convicted criminals.** That’s 1,150 chances we had to protect our communities, and we chose not to.
You’d think this would be the moment when Connecticut’s leaders—flush with power, given their supermajority—might step up and act like grown-ups. You’d be wrong.Instead, Attorney General William Tong has taken it upon himself to moonlight as the state’s head of the **#Resistance** , turning his office into a political war room. His latest target? Not drug traffickers, not gangs, not violent offenders. Nope. He’s decided that Avelo Airlines, a budget carrier just trying to operate within federal law, is the real villain here.
Avelo’s crime? Agreeing to a business decision to fly deportation flights on behalf of ICE. In response, Tong penned a scathing letter packed with loaded questions and moral outrage, demanding to know if Avelo would dare transport people in handcuffs or—gasp—without a valid “removal order.” (Because if they’re being deported without the proper paperwork, that’s the part we should be mad about.)Here’s a thought: maybe **the real atrocity isn’t Avelo’s compliance with federal law. Perhaps it’s our own government’s refusal to do its job.**
Tong’s letter reads like a parody. If he’s this outraged about air travel logistics, what’s his plan? Put these criminals on a Greyhound? Call them a Lyft to El Salvador? Does he think ICE should send them home with a gift card and a note that says, “Sorry for the inconvenience”?
While Tong is grandstanding and the legislature is busy earning us top marks in cost of living and bottom marks in economic growth, violent offenders are being quietly released back into our neighborhoods. So again, I ask: **Who exactly is our government working for?**
We need to stop pretending this is normal. It’s not. No functioning society decides the best use of its power is to protect lawbreakers while ignoring the rights of law-abiding citizens. We’ve effectively created sanctuary cities that act like open invitations for criminal migrants to slip through the cracks and land back on our streets—often with tragic results.
Let’s not sugarcoat this: the **Democrats own this mess**. They have the majority, the governor’s mansion, and the moral high ground they like to claim—but they’re not using any of that to make Connecticut safer. If anything, they’re sprinting in the opposite direction.
So here’s a final question, and it’s the one that matters most: What are we, the people of Connecticut, going to do about it?
**Call your state representative.** Call your senator. Show up. Speak up. Demand that the people in charge start prioritizing the citizens who pay the taxes raise the families and follow the laws—not the ones breaking them.
Donald Trump may have won a national mandate with the simple promise that America comes first. In Connecticut, we demand something just as fundamental: that citizens come first.
And maybe Attorney General William Tong should get on an airplane himself, enjoy the friendly skies he’s so concerned about, and fly down to Washington, D.C., to meet with Attorney General Pam Bondi and ICE Director Thomas Homan. **He might just learn what it truly means to be a top law enforcement official: someone who enforces the law, defends the public, and doesn’t confuse grandstanding with governance.**

* * *

MassGOP to MassDems: time to hold one of your own accountable
| | | | | [](https://qgzxgy5ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=00129WD-denAeK_u_zmE3QN0Lvo6mxkbcwX6B-SDg8a5LcwrgA-xMI7Uch-eQ2RFBkGdRCxehgcwQOV-EX7ArtzKJaDD680h75AFhkBm5j4C_qTvlq7EW_OTpyPid9Sh4SoTb4NcsdxKuoAEwUGAP60RQ==&c=sfHLviD_MAab3KGqSfCSNyrqHALhn8uPfgZduS80cHH-L6c9ZXgjCA==&ch=8DuA48kSqyBemaNQpS7hxOeVcpv9_G6WKZaKTUlpEv6wgK2fO7QYxA==)

| MassGOP urges MassDems to put the people of Massachusetts first, restore integrity in public service, and take a stand against corruption by demanding State Rep. Chris Flanagan's immediate resignation following his arrest on federal fraud charges.
Friend,
The word is out - Democrat State Representative Chris Flanagan was arrested this week on federal fraud charges.
The charges allege that Flanagan stole tens of thousands of dollars from his former employer to finance his political campaign, pay his mortgage and credit cards, and fund personal expenses including psychic services and high-end menswear.
Back in January, when the Office of Campaign and Political Finance found Flanagan responsible for violating campaign finance laws -- including fabricating a false alias to intentionally mislead his constituents into thinking he had Republican support -- we said then that he had no place in public office and should resign.
Today's news of the federal charges only confirm what was already evident: Chris Flanagan is unfit to serve, and Massachusetts Democrats must demand his resignation now.
It's about time the Democrats hold one of their own accountable.
But, between you and me, our call to action can't stop there. We must find and support Republican candidates committed to maintaining transparency and accountability, and doing right by their constituents, even when no one is looking. Especially then.

Chris Flanagan's immediate resignation following his arrest on federal fraud charges. Friend, The word is out - Democrat State Representative Chris Flanagan was arrested this week on federal fraud charges. The charges allege that Flanagan stole tens of thousands of dollars from his former employer to finance his political campaign, pay his mortgage and credit cards, and fund personal expenses including psychic services and high-end menswear. Back in January, when the Office of Campaign and Political Finance found Flanagan responsible for violating campaign finance laws -- including fabricating a false alias to intentionally mislead his constituents into thinking he had Republican support -- we said then that he had no place in public office and should resign. Today's news of the federal charges only confirm what was already evident: Chris Flanagan is unfit to serve, and Massachusetts Democrats must demand his resignation now. It's about time the Democrats hold one of their own accountable. But, between you and me, our call to action can't stop there. We must find and support Republican candidates committed to maintaining transparency and accountability, and doing right by their constituents, even when no one is looking. Brianna J. Rivers, 30, was arrested on one count of second-degree assault for reportedly punching Craven Antao in the face several times during a street interview in Harlem on the topic of abortion.

---
Hi Peter,

We are writing today because one of the most dangerous threats to women’s rights in America is now one step closer to becoming federal law.

Yesterday, the Republican-controlled House officially voted to pass the “Safeguard American Voter Eligibility” (SAVE) Act which would result in the disenfranchisement of millions of eligible voters. You may have heard about this bill and how it would impact millions of American women... Now that Republicans have a trifecta in Washington, it could easily become law.

**Here is just one reason why this matters:**
This bill would have a devastating impact on women – **most notably on the approximately 69 million women in America who legally changed their last names when they got married** – because the SAVE Act **requires** a _birth certificate that matches the name of the person registering to vote._
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/105636233/538907734/1701071684?refcode=EM_F_250411SAVE_N_JZ_90DO_9_G_N_P1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjA0NmYyZjExLWQ5MTYtZjAxMS04YjNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=KvOIjvs4lbcHlMb58OePdfRmzVccRS4sT2bwdXOmKhI=)
---
On April 1st, Congresswoman Maxine Dexter gave her colleagues a chance to protect women’s voting rights by introducing an amendment to the bill that would block it from being implemented unless Congress could guarantee that no eligible married women be denied the right to vote. **Republicans voted it down.**

[**At Her Bold Move, we were not surprised to learn that a Congresswoman stood up against this anti-woman policy. As male legislators continue to pass dangerous laws about women’s bodies, healthcare, and hard-fought rights, we desperately need to elect as many women as we can to offices across the country. Join us in our fight to do just that by donating $25 today. →**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/105636235/538907736/1701071684?refcode=EM_F_250411SAVE_N_JZ_90DO_9_G_N_L1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjA0NmYyZjExLWQ5MTYtZjAxMS04YjNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=KvOIjvs4lbcHlMb58OePdfRmzVccRS4sT2bwdXOmKhI=)

We will be monitoring the progress of this bill in the Senate and will keep you posted. In the meantime, we remain deeply concerned about the implications this would have on millions of Americans who might not have access to birth certificates, passports, or the documentation this bill would require them to present in order to exercise their constitutional right to vote.

name: Office of U.S. Senator Angela Alsobrooks
subject: Senator Alsobrooks Newsletter -- April 11
body:
|

---
Friends and neighbors, We've been working hard for you, and it's been a busy week here in Washington and across the state. We're witnessing the Administration reeling as this tariff debacle continues to spiral out of control. The markets crashed. Americans' 401(k)s got slashed. And even with this so-called "pause," the average American family will see their costs go up this year by over $4,000. All of this was avoidable. I will continue to push back against these tariffs and fight for middle and working class families. I've got a busy week coming up in Maryland, and I'm excited to share new resources and upcoming opportunities to connect. **I'd Love to See You** Next week, I'll be out and about around the state, meeting Marylanders where they are. We are excited to host an open house for our new state office in Bowie. Please register to attend by clicking [here](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=14234.6872645.5233860.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fforms.gle%2fFEBmWcLYrA2WjqLv8&redir_log=988247563242233). You can meet some of our state team throughout the day, and I look forward to dropping in later that evening. Our Bowie office open house is just the first, and I look forward to seeing Marylanders as we continue to ramp up all of our outreach efforts. **Fighting for You** I stayed on the Senate floor last Friday night into Saturday morning fighting against a Republican budget that will devastate Maryland's working class families. I even introduced a series of amendments that would have protected collective bargaining for our federal workers, saved federal workers' jobs, prohibited tax increases on single parents, and more. Republicans refused to even bring most of them to the floor. It remains painfully clear that this Administration prioritizes billionaires at the expense of working class families. We are going to make sure this Administration understands what's at stake and who will pay the price if they gut Social Security and Medicaid for the ultra rich. I urge you to use your collective voices to speak out because what becomes more evident each day is that this Administration caves under the pressure of the American people. So stay in the fight! **Demanding Answers** As I've promised you, I have been fighting against this Administration's tactics legislatively and this week we've dug in - seeking answers and justice for the American people. This week, I led Senators from Maryland and Virginia in [demanding](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=14234.6872645.5233860.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.alsobrooks.senate.gov%2fpress-releases%2ficymi-politico-morning-money-senator-alsobrooks-leads-dmv-senators-in-demanding-back-pay-for-rehired-civil-servants%2f&redir_log=753425021871158) back pay for rehired civil servants at the Department of Housing and Urban Development. We demanded answers and clarity on how many workers were rehired, when they can expect back pay, and when they will return to their jobs and continue serving the American people. Additionally, Senator Van Hollen and I joined Senators Patty Murray, Bernie Sanders, Tammy Baldwin and others in [demanding answers](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=14234.6872645.5233860.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.alsobrooks.senate.gov%2fpress-releases%2fvan-hollen-alsobrooks-murray-sanders-baldwin-demand-answers-on-trump-rfk-jr-ripping-12-billion-away-from-communities-to-tackle-public-health-threats-opioids-crisis-more%2f&redir_log=637080042281525) from Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. on the Trump Administration's abrupt decision to strip $12 billion in funding to local, state and Tribal jurisdictions to address public health threats, the substance use and mental health crisis, and more. We've seen a victory in court, and following a lawsuit filed with 23 states and DC, including Maryland, a judge temporarily barred HHS from cutting grants, noting the states had made a strong case. We must continue the pressure to ensure this Administration knows that funding approved by Congress cannot be withdrawn out of spite, or to pad the wallets of billionaires. And finally, as you know, I sit on the Committee on Banking, Housing and Urban Affairs, and I've joined my Democratic colleagues in [urging](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=14234.6872645.5233860.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.banking.senate.gov%2fimo%2fmedia%2fdoc%2fletter_to_chair_scott1.pdf&redir_log=17846814862500) Chairman Tim Scott to hold a hearing on President Trump's use of the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) to implement his tariff agenda. So far, all we've seen with his tariffs is chaos devoid of strategy. We would also like to know if he will once again hand out exceptions to his friends or companies he's tied to, at the expense of everyone else - as he did in his first term. I think Marylanders deserve these answers and more, and I will keep pressing forward to seek clarity, truth, and resolution to these cruel and failed policies. **In The Community** I was honored to break ground on the new Civic Plaza in Largo. It's part of the Blue Line Corridor project I developed as Prince George's County Executive, and this is the first project to come out of the ground. Through working in a bipartisan way, I secured $400 million in bonding authority for the first time in County history, to bring long awaited amenities to communities that have gone without real investment. This is proof of what can happen when we have a bold vision and act on it, and I will fight for resources so that we can bring vision to reality all across this state. It was wonderful to meet with more than 200 high school students as part of Senator Ben Cardin's Jewish Scholars Program. These young people are our next generation of leaders dedicated to making our world more just. I was honored to meet with the Maryland representatives of the National Association of Postal Supervisors this week. I am proud to stand with the United States Postal Service - a reliable and affordable service for the American people, and the largest civilian employer of veterans. **Tell Us Your Stories** I know that many Marylanders are hurting right now. Not only in the wake of all of the economic uncertainty, but quite literally because they've lost their jobs. The patriots who have, for decades, ensured that American families had the resources they need, deserve, and rely on -- and have now been placed on administrative leave or have been cruelly laid-off. Your stories are powerful. Your stories help us in this resistance. Your stories help us fight to preserve the very essence of our democracy. We have recently launched a portal on our [website](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=14234.6872645.5233860.7190525&report_id=&redirect=http%3a%2f%2falsobrooks.senate.gov%2f&redir_log=346519414955204) to collect those stories. But please know that I will continue fighting for you every step of the way. We will not give up. We will not give in to this Administration, and I ask that you continue to fight alongside us. Please continue to reach out to us. You can call the office, connect with us, or find resources for those who have recently been laid off at [alsobrooks.senate.gov](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=14234.6872645.5233860.7190525&report_id=&redirect=http%3a%2f%2falsobrooks.senate.gov&redir_log=983830187668200). # **STEVE ROBERTS**
# **St. Louis**
---
Weekly Update - April 11, 2025
---
| |
---
**Senator Steven Roberts - Remarks on Senate Bill 35** _"The Revitalizing Missouri Downtowns and Main Streets Act"_
Colleagues, neighbors, and friends,
We can transform Downtown St. Louis and communities across our state back into the vibrant, thriving places we know they can be. But before we can fix what’s broken, we must first be honest about what the challenges are.
Downtown St. Louis faces a steep decline in demand for commercial
office space—while, at the same time, the cost of housing continues to rise. The logical solution seems obvious: convert underused office buildings into much-needed housing. And yet, these conversions remain rare because, for developers, they’ve historically been costly, complicated, and risky. As a result, these buildings sit vacant—doing little for our communities and even less for our economy.
Additionally, both the City of St. Louis and the state as a whole have
seen stagnant population growth. This makes it harder for businesses to recruit and retain the talent they need. We know young people want to study in St. Louis—but far too often, they leave after graduation. They don’t see enough opportunity to live, work, and thrive here.
Finally, too many of Missouri’s historic main streets—once the
beating heart of our cities and towns—are deteriorating. With fewer people working and walking downtown, small businesses have closed, foot traffic has dropped, and public safety has suffered. These trends are connected, and their impact has been deeply harmful to the spirit and future of Downtown St. Louis.
When housing is limited, affordable options become even scarcer. When we fail to attract and keep talent, our economic growth stalls. When our main streets empty, we risk losing not just our small businesses, but our cultural identity and sense of place.
We must reverse these trends.
That’s why I introduced [Senate Bill 35: The Revitalizing Missouri Downtowns and Main Streets Act](http://url5914.robertsforstl.com/ls/click?upn=u001.fzG53TkBvmRvO32ahM-2BnoTAzfPYg4QsBmRSXo3mMrIuayvDinXRDWfiNBxREWPuvkLZZTSB39yPW1xXTy737LnqHkNjVE-2BhyiZeVcG2d6t8hQStU80iV1UkvsJ276lDEjaHI_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVCKy-2B-2B58EQo9OBZ1DFkEmwuM7vQygzizVvxKmA-2F9J-2FE19DrCJBiChnWEt1YTcce0486aCCtakNmtIV2Bwhjynf9Hi6ChikaWGsW2E-2FoTBQUw2kNJN-2B-2BRqCUGZIYKTWg3Jzwco3ls9O-2Fmr39aIc3mZ18zvT1OsSK8mY-2F-2BNDrAuJQb4trxGe1bzgZgHnmkRdk9p7-2BYG6HMHK5XswBSfGKj57c-2FOHqk7uNU6ACFvbuitegARLK07T87an4RdVr44jUgT1kVqQRZeAr-2BlP6yNGA-2FaiQW3aqJa7aJFNVTkgDe6T9EmlYbADtIqg3c-2B3R-2B3NU0CKCq9wN69fpDKk72vN6WBpe3Mu4Bxa6lcgaX2Io-2BkuALDOZCM-2Fr-2BB8e6RZWE2Y6PL2YEOucbVVdZyN4Frtgn4qxb3KfJfiYHwtL8lgOoQD7CYtTkzuNbgcjVEZnSLI7C9AWdTSSOmYvgNulnGChZ0cHgJSR7e9vLMuFYaoynYnwIAAilc-2BUtPucBN5pHUdu7dLbFFlSj1t-2B6S2h1GaClZQ80FgV9tafYxetGd7Y0C3gq4ILkGOazzBenkw-2FH1PR7JwgQiWqRrLqRx8FHxVV2YORjH7MY02gsDHgBniBy4nii2a0tG5j26eH0aqXM7RUd-2BqNbvqlsRZkQQvHwca4b3jSScsjdGnLSHns64H9G7WTYsKJsWa8Uv2kos9OEqJW9-2FG4tgOVO8O-2F-2FInZz0M3jAOv5gkl7HrGndnkpxDMecov03Rqq8vUwJdmKKMXWAJ6PVX7in-2F8YNFRVtDlPepJPfUZb8HwXpngemjt8N79i6273dmrKpeetspSvLqEbSp-2BXdzRUxOAEwGj17VEDd8Nkau-2Bd2eZqS9Uw-2F3A0cueDQpz-2Bw-3D-3D). This legislation is a targeted, practical solution designed to spark new life into our urban cores and main streets.
SB 35 creates a tax credit system to encourage the conversion of nonresidential buildings—especially vacant offices—into predominantly residential spaces, as well as projects that create upper-floor housing in Missouri's designated main streets.
This legislation also ensures that both urban and rural communities benefit—helping us protect and reinvigorate Missouri’s historic and cultural corridors.
This bill has earned the strong support for one clear reason: it fills a real need. It offers a pathway for private investment, unlocks development potential, and lays the foundation for more livable, walkable, economically vibrant communities.
If we want to rebuild the heart of our cities—if we want to keep talent here, create jobs, and preserve the soul of our main streets—then we must act. SB 35 is a forward-thinking, solutions-oriented bill.
Let’s transform unused spaces into opportunity.
Let’s restore our main streets.
Let’s build a brighter, more prosperous Missouri—for all of us.

---
|

**About Steve Roberts**
Senator Steven Roberts, a fourth-generation St. Louis native, was sworn into office on January 6, 2021, to represent Missouri’s 5th Senatorial District and currently serves as the Assistant Minority Floor Leader. Previously, he served in the Missouri House of Representatives from 2017 to 2020 and chaired the Missouri Legislative Black Caucus. A graduate of the University of Miami and Pepperdine Law, he has worked in Congress, as a prosecutor in St. Louis, and as a Captain in the Missouri Air National Guard’s JAG Corps. He also manages Roberts Law, LLC, and remains active in Missouri’s legal and civic communities.

It's no coincidence that corporate media outlets are silent about their own collapsing trust and plummeting viewership. The public is exhausted--fed up with sensationalized headlines, a lack of accountability for the powerful, and the constant churn of half-truths and spin. The consequences are clear: mass unsubscribes, declining readership, and audiences tuning out entirely. But there _are_ ways forward--real, practical solutions to ensure people get the honest, clear information they need to stay informed and empowered. So where do we begin? **Let 's Address This**.
**I am doing everything in my power over the next four years to stave off fascism in the United States, and I need your support.** **Subscribe and join the movement.**
[ Upgrade to paid](https://substack..ZL-KpOHrkCS8ckERNwcYYoNJ1yA8gi5SSvOA50rIelw?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=161059018)

---|---|---
[Screen Grab: David Pakman Show]
## How bad is distrust in legacy media?
Plummeting trust in legacy media is hitting record levels. Gallup Polling from just this February [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/bb379a6e-4a5f-4c93-91f5-cf3d7518878d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> About two-thirds of Americans in the 1970s trusted the "mass media -- such as newspapers, TV and radio" either "a great deal" or "a fair amount" to "[report] the news fully, accurately and fairly." By the next measurement in 1997, confidence had fallen to 53%, and it has gradually trended downward since 2003. Americans [are now divided into rough thirds](https://substack.com/redirect/9ccf0bfa-434d-45ad-b4bc-2d23fbfc5ed2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), with 31% trusting the media a great deal or a fair amount, 33% saying they do "not [trust it] very much," and 36%, up from 6% in 1972, saying they have no trust at all in it.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/51fca976-ce75-4acf-85d0-77ad2ad2a9f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This begs a very important question: How can the American people procure reliable and accurate information?
## Two Solutions to Legacy Media Failures
1. **Independent Media:** Finding trustworthy, fact-based reporting--especially when it comes to human rights--is harder than ever in today's media landscape. That's why independent platforms and mission-driven writers matter so deeply. I created _[Let's Address This with Qasim Rashid](https://substack.com/redirect/2d6ed0c4-ec3d-4ab0-a61f-30ee6b9f8516?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ to fill that gap--to offer clear, evidence-backed analysis on the human rights crises too often ignored by mainstream outlets. Because of your support, this community has grown to more than 127,000 subscribers--in less than 1 year--united by a shared belief in truth, justice, and thoughtful conversation.

Making sure the information I share is accurate and trustworthy is a responsibility I don't take lightly. I use a range of tools and verification methods to cross-reference every source I cite--so when you see a fact in my work, you can trust it's grounded in real, confirmable evidence. What guides that process?
2. **Media Transparency Tools:** One of the most valuable tools I use is [Ground News](https://substack.com/redirect/6eb1d1aa-d7e4-41c5-8e0e-16d802f559ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which helps me provide the trustworthy analysis you expect and deserve.

The challenge we've faced for too long is figuring out which headlines reflect the truth, which are twisted, and which are outright biased. That's where Ground News truly shifts the landscape. Their website and app bring together coverage from around the world on any given story, so you can see exactly how different outlets are reporting it--making it easier to cut through the noise, spot the bias, and get to the facts. It's a powerful tool for anyone who wants to engage with the news critically and confidently.

name: Michael Bennet
subject: I’m running
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Bennet for Governor
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_mfb_email-25q2-g?refcode=X_250411_launch1_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_mfb_email-25q2-g?refcode=X_250411_launch1_act]
Friend,
I wanted to share with you that I’m running for Governor of Colorado.
My parents raised me with the belief that we have a responsibility to build a better future for each other and our country. That belief has guided my career—from serving as a school superintendent to fighting for Colorado as your Senator.
Together, we’ve made real progress: we expanded the Child Tax Credit, which cut childhood poverty nearly in half; we lowered prescription drug costs and ended surprise hospital bills; and in four years, we secured $12 billion in federal funding to improve Colorado’s infrastructure and support our communities.
Unlike most Coloradans, Donald Trump does not believe in building opportunities for the next generation. He believes in taking a wrecking ball to our economy and democracy.
While Trump pursues chaos, it is getting harder to live in Colorado. Housing, healthcare, and childcare cost too much. Our schools and businesses are struggling. Those of us who are parents worry that our kids will never be able to raise their own families here.
We know our best solutions to these challenges will not come from Washington’s broken politics. Our best solutions will come from us. That’s why I’m running for Governor of Colorado.
If you’re ready to jump in with me, click here to watch my launch video about my vision for Colorado, then consider chipping in and becoming a Founding Donor to this campaign. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_mfb_email-25q2-g?refcode=X_250411_launch1_act]
Colorado can be a beacon of hope—at a time when things seem at their darkest. Colorado can provide the vision and leadership our country so desperately needs. Working together, we can make healthcare, housing, and childcare more affordable. We can make it easier for entrepreneurs to start and grow small businesses. We can bring our education system into the 21st century and lead the fight against climate change.
It’s here—in Colorado—that we can best fight Trump’s corruption while building a brighter future for our kids and grandkids. A future that focuses on all of us, not just the wealthy few.
Friend, I recorded a video about my vision for this campaign and for Colorado. I want you to be among the first to see it. You can click here to watch, then chip in whatever you can to become one of our Founding Donors. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_mfb_email-25q2-g?refcode=X_250411_launch1_act]

Thank you for being part of this team. We can show America a better path forward and lead from right here in Colorado. Let’s get to work.
Thank you,
Michael Bennet
