name: Hoosiers for Haggard
subject: A busy week of Legislation!
body:
While the statehouse session is almost over, our votes are still just as important!

| | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/3b64b1edc55c/a-busy-week-of-legislation?e=72dace1453)
---
|
---
| | | | |
---
|
# Updates from the Statehouse
---
|
---
| This week, I have been active in the statehouse working on passing common-sense conservative legislation. Now that we are in the final stretch of the legislative season, I wanted to provide some updates on what we accomplished so far in legislation and include an update on some of the bills I authored.
---
|

1. Worked on greater protection of property rights to further strengthen criminalization of squatters and trespassers. (SB219)
2. Worked to introduce greater awareness to human trafficking by sponsoring a bill later adopted in another bill to increase worker training to respond and notice human trafficking at lodging and food locations
3. Strengthened the regulations of bare knuckle boxing with wording coordinated with the Indiana Boxing Commission. (HB 1073)
4. Co-Authored a resolution to work with INDOT to rename the bridge over Big Walnut Creek in honor of fallen sheriff James Baugh. (SCR 11)
5. Co-Authored a bill to remove regulation and prioritize development of Small Modular Nuclear Reactors for energy and research in Indiana.(HB 1007)
6. Worked to represent my constituents and bring greater awareness to the growing issue of property taxes and authored 2 bills that looked to reign them in and ensure the public is able to greater pay for their own land. (HB 1075)
7. Passed common-sense vote on allowing candidates to declare political parties in school board races if they want. (SB 287)
8. Passed tougher restrictions on illegal immigration and ensured law enforcement has more adequate resources to combat immigration enforcement. (HB 1393)
9. Passed a balanced budget that worked to cut waste and save taxpayer money.
10. Established stronger guidelines for education by changing some of the guidelines for schools to have more control over local decisions (HB 1002)

---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | This past weekend, I made it up to Newton County for their annual Lincoln Day Dinner to meet with some of the county leaders and discuss our important work going on in the statehouse. I was glad to be welcomed into the county and I look forward to coming back.
---
|
---
| Next I had the great honor to speak at Indiana Federation of Republican Women’s Spring meeting. I talked about the role Republican women provide in getting Republicans elected and congratulated them for their hard work and dedication the party. Thank you IFRW President Sovilla Mennen for introducing me and the warm welcome that came with it.
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
|
---
| To end a packed week and a half, I joined fellow Republicans for the State Dinner downtown where I was glad to meet many of the local leaders that make our state great! Thank you Oklahoma Governor Kevin Stitt for joining us and showing us the value of conservative leadership.
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | Finally I wrote another Op-ed about my work to protect our land from foreign threats for the Morgan County Correspondent and I encourage you to check it out!
---
| | [Morgan County Correspondent Article](https://hoosiersforhaggard.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9e7cbafb97c2110b065cece3&id=8a0cbb1b69&e=72dace1453)
---
|
---
| Make sure to always reach out if you have questions and I look forward to providing updates about the state house and will be travelling the district again soon!
---

Peter — this week, Trump gave us all a masterclass in reckless, self-serving leadership. **FIRST:** Donald Trump announced a sweeping new set of global tariffs — a backdoor national sales tax on the American people that would hike prices on food, gas, clothing, and everyday essentials. **THEN:** Economists across the spectrum sounded the alarm. ### From Community College to Congress, I know what it means to 'fail forward.'
| | [Patrick J. Murphy](https://substack.com/@patrickmurphypa)

You hear the phrase "growth mentality" tossed around a lot these days--on LinkedIn, on podcasts, in TED Talks, etc. But for me, it's never been a slogan. It's just how I've lived my life.
I was the first generation in my family to go to college. I applied to exactly one four-year school and got rejected. So I pivoted. I enrolled full-time at Bucks County Community College, worked four jobs (including waiting tables on the graveyard shift at Perkins, which was exactly as glamorous as it sounds), and still managed to make the Dean's List.
A year later, the same college that told me I wasn't good enough offered me a scholarship. By junior year, I earned a full ride.
No one called it a "growth mentality" back then. I just knew I had to keep going.
We live in a culture obsessed with winning. But the truth is every meaningful thing I've ever done started with _failure._
I learned early on that no one hands you a second chance. You earn it. You stay hungry. And along the way, you grow. But first, you fail. A lot.
And you don't stay there without learning how to take a hit and get back up smarter.
I've carried that mindset with me through a lot of chapters in my life. Like when I lost reelection to Congress in 2010--part of a red wave that swept out 63 Democrats. I didn't retreat. I was at the train station the very next morning thanking voters for giving me the honor to serve them for four years and that I planned to run through the tape the next two months. I rewrote the Murphy Amendment to repeal "Don't Ask, Don't Tell"--and it passed. Thousands of LGBTQ+ service members could finally serve openly for the country they love.
That wasn't my first time in a high-stakes fight. I served in Baghdad with the 82nd Airborne Division, helped rebuild the Iraqi justice system, and took on terrorists that were killing innocent nine-year-olds. It was heartbreaking, but we didn't give an inch, even in 138-degree heat. Before that, I was just a skinny Philly kid working security in the notoriously rowdy 700 Level at Eagles games, dodging beer cans after doing homework before my shift. Not exactly the standard path to Congress or the Pentagon.
Last week on Fox News, I talked about how most major political leaders-- from Ronald Reagan and George Bush, to Bill Clinton to Barack Obama--have all lost elections. What sets real leaders apart isn't that they never fall. It's that they get back up, learn from it, and move forward with a little more wisdom and a lot more grit. It's not about perfection. It's about persistence.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/e766442a-1d0a-4eb4-a6cf-35c049bf9e12?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Secretary Murphy on Fox News
[Subscribed](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9wYXRyaWNrbXVycGh5cGEuc3Vic3RhY2suY29tL2FjY291bnQiLCJwIjoxNjExMDMyOTUsInMiOjQzOTkxMzMsImYiOnRydWUsInUiOjkwNTAxMTkyLCJpYXQiOjE3NDQzODQyMzIsImV4cCI6MTc0Njk3NjIzMiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTAiLCJzdWIiOiJsaW5rLXJlZGlyZWN0In0.tP7g4q2c4QbBcKiACYkuzsQ7MgXXBgQwRTgqxWqnC24?)
That same resilience is what's missing in too many of today's institutions.
This week may have offered President Trump a chance to show a measure of humility and even growth. And while the bar is low, he may have cleared it--if just barely. Did President Trump screw up with universal tariffs this past week?Yes. I and millions of others called him out on it. The fallout was swift and justified: markets reeled, allies panicked, and even Trump's own supporters voiced concern. After mounting pressure from key figures like hedge fund billionaire Bill Ackman, Elon Musk, and other advisors he derided as ["yippy," ](https://substack.com/redirect/c5745cee-dbd1-4965-bd6e-929456a32d66?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)Trump reversed course. The White House paused most of the tariffs for 90 days, while keeping a 10% baseline in place to preserve leverage in negotiations.
To his credit, he listened. Course corrections require something increasingly rare in American leadership: the willingness to admit you may be wrong.
He went on to meet with [Michigan Governor Gretchen Whitmer](https://substack.com/redirect/797a01b5-1eb5-446b-b9b1-c4eab209c7a4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--a Democrat who's long been one of his most vocal critics--and treated her with a level of respect that surprised many. Whether driven by strategy, optics, or genuine reconsideration is hard to say. But these moments, however small, matter nonetheless.
This type of leadership gives me some hope. Whether it's in boardrooms or the halls of government, people are afraid to be wrong. I used to tell my paratroopers in Iraq, if you're afraid to get hurt, you will. Be confident in the training that you got here, but don't be afraid to adapt and grow. Fear keeps too many stuck--not just in bad policy, but in stale thinking. It's not just a failure of leadership. It's a failure of humility and imagination.
You can't lead if you don't keep learning. You can't govern if you won't grow.
And you sure as hell can't solve anything if you're too proud to try again.
So yeah, I've lost. I've failed plenty--more times than I care to admit. But I've never stopped showing up and moving forward.
Whether you're in a boardroom or on a ballot, in my Wharton class or running a company, here's my challenge to you: fail better. Genuinely learn from it, don't make excuses, and get the hell up. And do it better next time by getting back in the fight.
That's the truth about growth that no one ever tells you.
Before you grow, you fail.
And if you're doing it right, you fail forward.
And then eventually, you might even fail better.
That's what a growth mentality really looks like. And that's what this moment is calling for. Just show others grace when they fail, because chances are you might be next.
\- Patrick

From Community College to Congress, I know what it means to 'fail forward.' | | | Apr 11 | | | | | | | | | | | | You hear the phrase "growth mentality" tossed around a lot these days--on LinkedIn, on podcasts, in TED Talks, etc. But for me, it's never been a slogan. It's just how I've lived my life. I was the first generation in my family to go to college. I applied to exactly one four-year school and got rejected. So I pivoted. I enrolled full-time at Bucks County Community College, worked four jobs (including waiting tables on the graveyard shift at Perkins, which was exactly as glamorous as it sounds), and still managed to make the Dean's List. A year later, the same college that told me I wasn't good enough offered me a scholarship. By junior year, I earned a full ride. No one called it a "growth mentality" back then. I just knew I had to keep going. We live in a culture obsessed with winning. But the truth is every meaningful thing I've ever done started with failure. I learned early on that no one hands you a second chance. You earn it. You stay hungry. And along the way, you grow. But first, you fail. A lot. And you don't stay there without learning how to take a hit and get back up smarter. I've carried that mindset with me through a lot of chapters in my life. Like when I lost reelection to Congress in 2010--part of a red wave that swept out 63 Democrats. I didn't retreat. I was at the train station the very next morning thanking voters for giving me the honor to serve them for four years and that I planned to run through the tape the next two months. I rewrote the Murphy Amendment to repeal "Don't Ask, Don't Tell"--and it passed. Thousands of LGBTQ+ service members could finally serve openly for the country they love. That wasn't my first time in a high-stakes fight. I served in Baghdad with the 82nd Airborne Division, helped rebuild the Iraqi justice system, and took on terrorists that were killing innocent nine-year-olds. It was heartbreaking, but we didn't give an inch, even in 138-degree heat. Before that, I was just a skinny Philly kid working security in the notoriously rowdy 700 Level at Eagles games, dodging beer cans after doing homework before my shift. Not exactly the standard path to Congress or the Pentagon. Last week on Fox News, I talked about how most major political leaders-- from Ronald Reagan and George Bush, to Bill Clinton to Barack Obama--have all lost elections. What sets real leaders apart isn't that they never fall. It's that they get back up, learn from it, and move forward with a little more wisdom and a lot more grit. It's not about perfection. It's about persistence. Secretary Murphy on Fox News ? That same resilience is what's missing in too many of today's institutions. This week may have offered President Trump a chance to show a measure of humility and even growth. And while the bar is low, he may have cleared it--if just barely. Did President Trump screw up with universal tariffs this past week?Yes. I and millions of others called him out on it. The fallout was swift and justified: markets reeled, allies panicked, and even Trump's own supporters voiced concern. After mounting pressure from key figures like hedge fund billionaire Bill Ackman, Elon Musk, and other advisors he derided as reversed course. The White House paused most of the tariffs for 90 days, while keeping a 10% baseline in place to preserve leverage in negotiations. To his credit, he listened. Course corrections require something increasingly rare in American leadership: the willingness to admit you may be wrong. He went on to meet with Democrat who's long been one of his most vocal critics--and treated her with a level of respect that surprised many. Whether driven by strategy, optics, or genuine reconsideration is hard to say. But these moments, however small, matter nonetheless. This type of leadership gives me some hope. Whether it's in boardrooms or the halls of government, people are afraid to be wrong. I used to tell my paratroopers in Iraq, if you're afraid to get hurt, you will. Be confident in the training that you got here, but don't be afraid to adapt and grow. Fear keeps too many stuck--not just in bad policy, but in stale thinking. It's not just a failure of leadership. It's a failure of humility and imagination. You can't lead if you don't keep learning. You can't govern if you won't grow. And you sure as hell can't solve anything if you're too proud to try again. So yeah, I've lost. I've failed plenty--more times than I care to admit. But I've never stopped showing up and moving forward. Whether you're in a boardroom or on a ballot, in my Wharton class or running a company, here's my challenge to you: fail better. Genuinely learn from it, don't make excuses, and get the hell up. And do it better next time by getting back in the fight. That's the truth about growth that no one ever tells you. Before you grow, you fail. And if you're doing it right, you fail forward. And then eventually, you might even fail better. That's what a growth mentality really looks like. And that's what this moment is calling for. Just show others grace when they fail, because chances are you might be next. \- Patrick The Honorable Patrick J. Murphy is a Wharton lecturer, Vetrepreneur, and the 32nd Army Under Secretary after earning the Bronze Star for service in Baghdad, Iraq as an All-American with the 82nd Airborne Division --@PatrickMurphyPA on Instagram and Twitter. | Ken Mitchell has spent his life in service—to his country, his community, and his family. A veteran with 24 years of military experience, a small business owner, and an infrastructure expert, Ken has the leadership and real-world experience we need in Congress.
---
| From serving in the White House in an apolitical role under two presidents to working on infrastructure projects across Virginia, Ken has always put people over politics. He understands what it means to work with diverse teams, solve complex problems, and get things done. His work in telecommunications showed him how vital broadband access is to rural communities, and his experience as a contractor and small business owner has given him firsthand knowledge of the challenges that families and workers face every day.
---
| | | | | | | | | | | [Donate Now!](https://kenmitchellforvirginia.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=435990a56c5fdf5272fa9ea86&id=ae08463ffd&e=0fced71d8c)
---
| Our current incumbent, Rep. Ben Cline, doesn’t work for you—he works for Donald Trump. Cline has stood by as Trump has:
---
| ● Pardoned January 6 rioters who attacked our democracy● Pulled the U.S. out of the World Health Organization, endangering global health efforts● Escalated attacks on migrants, including innocent children● Blocked refugee travel, even for those already cleared for resettlement● Slashed the federal workforce and stripped union rights from federal employees● Turned a blind eye to leaked war plans from his top officials
---
| Ben Cline has done nothing to fight for Virginians—he has only fought to keep Trump happy. He has ignored the real issues facing our communities, from crumbling infrastructure to the need for better wages, stronger unions, and investments in rural development. Cline supports Trump’s vision for America—one where corporations profit while working families struggle, where government services are gutted, and where only the wealthiest and most powerful get ahead.
---
| We deserve better. Ken has worked across industries—from telecommunications to historic renovation to water infrastructure—always focused on improving lives. He believes in investing in rural communities, protecting workers, and ensuring government works for the people, not just corporations, billionaires and extremists.

body:
I'm humbly asking you to read this, so you can understand why I care so much about this race
| [ ](http://links.tubervilleforalabama.com/u/click?_t=b8b4efbe79f64b579dfa7d8da685a7a9&_m=99a767476ec44d999c9f25427621a5ab&_e=mlp3USE1wOhrcEdm3fKik_EVvNjw6_IsE0_9EENeaw3gk3Z32J3xijwsw9sszqx0LTQ_CxVGi0dd6nj291i_0_iAZCqAchXLSA0chvKrojwilxacQQfBVrYe3eieHsy106aUpaHSU5NWj9MAbBtz_1Ol28xy839PjnZgx7HVdfEZAOjm-v6evTJztzbiNbCBNO5FFo_1-wZWXrx6I7miBFR5cqLUitUNzmRA4-naZ27EJVt8ecGdWCAhFbxxf9fx66gF0m0S5b2rcPodC-6Mmry2G5phu-nKdl_fmFBXlXIBszZbwAg7S0MV4p3VOyB02AXIRWZC7M-fzCd8bz96PQ%3D%3D)
---
Peter,

**My son, who was a U.S. Marine and father of two, was murdered in 2016 when he was just 28 years old.**

[**This is a longer email, but I humbly ask you to read it and consider joining my team at the end.**](http://links.tubervilleforalabama.com/u/click?_t=b8b4efbe79f64b579dfa7d8da685a7a9&_m=99a767476ec44d999c9f25427621a5ab&_e=mlp3USE1wOhrcEdm3fKik_EVvNjw6_IsE0_9EENeaw3gk3Z32J3xijwsw9sszqx0LTQ_CxVGi0dd6nj291i_0_iAZCqAchXLSA0chvKrojwilxacQQfBVrYe3eieHsy106aUpaHSU5NWj9MAbBtz_1Ol28xy839PjnZgx7HVdfEZAOjm-v6evTJztzbiNbCBRcQv444hflyNOPwKQkKNfsHNkvXGIh7bmiv8_maplktXe8beJ9KV4BzSUM7Qy_J95OfH9Io_syIKGzSzcpsi6hP_GZmrMTBPiqMVLe7ZTe27s7HICNXrnYHi2413eZl8nZ4royWRT4ln4v4NOsaitw%3D%3D)

**In case you don 't know me, my name is Joe Males, and I'm a proud Mexican-American, U.S. Marine Veteran, small business owner, and a city councilman who's running for Congress in CA-25. But above all else, I'm a father who is still in mourning.**

[](http://links.tubervilleforalabama.com/u/click?_t=b8b4efbe79f64b579dfa7d8da685a7a9&_m=99a767476ec44d999c9f25427621a5ab&_e=mlp3USE1wOhrcEdm3fKik_EVvNjw6_IsE0_9EENeaw3gk3Z32J3xijwsw9sszqx0LTQ_CxVGi0dd6nj291i_0_iAZCqAchXLSA0chvKrojwilxacQQfBVrYe3eieHsy106aUpaHSU5NWj9MAbBtz_1Ol28xy839PjnZgx7HVdfEZAOjm-v6evTJztzbiNbCBtDZMxOyjanZA_raFWkqUgYyL8apDakkyUnDgB4XiXySXb-XI2OcPBgvKe8Z58QoY51wN8IL3h_tbzsbEqmXJklQ2zVIaTeUKr_SpbUt45W8WUk3IYJic5NRKHmoIBRrVJ4jaS0EiNV3lW_jbwA30GA%3D%3D)
**I ran for city council and am running for Congress because of my son, Nicholas.**

In 2016, Nicholas came home to visit for his sister's birthday and Father's Day. It was supposed to be a wonderful time to bring our family back together. Then, he was tragically stabbed to death in my hometown of Hemet, California.

[](http://links.tubervilleforalabama.com/u/click?_t=b8b4efbe79f64b579dfa7d8da685a7a9&_m=99a767476ec44d999c9f25427621a5ab&_e=mlp3USE1wOhrcEdm3fKik_EVvNjw6_IsE0_9EENeaw3gk3Z32J3xijwsw9sszqx0LTQ_CxVGi0dd6nj291i_0_iAZCqAchXLSA0chvKrojwilxacQQfBVrYe3eieHsy106aUpaHSU5NWj9MAbBtz_1Ol28xy839PjnZgx7HVdfEZAOjm-v6evTJztzbiNbCBqaKx4NE37YJ1lFtkon9oul6UxkfSM_fDt4o6R1UnDPGlOYN9evnfC9q-Y35ZFQhnHvEUVfT9fJyF2KKMdXe_ZA97E-FWqDSarS6uRp-3nMAXemsR4KVJDx_xqNdA_ulai_n5w7cQeaSzrLG2Su-I9A%3D%3D)
No one stepped forward with information on my son's killer, so the case went cold. After five years of not knowing anything about what happened, I decided to do something about it. I ran for City Council, and just a few months later, by the grace of God, they found the killer.

As a parent, losing your child is the most difficult thing to go through. But I'm pushing through it and am committed to making him proud as I fight for a better tomorrow for his children.

I'm grateful to Hemet's law enforcement, who was able to find the killer and arrest him.

Nicholas serves as a daily reminder to me to never take a single precious moment for granted and that I must continue to fight every single day for a better future.

[**Now, I 'm running for United States Congress to FLIP California's 25th district RED.**](http://links.tubervilleforalabama.com/u/click?_t=b8b4efbe79f64b579dfa7d8da685a7a9&_m=99a767476ec44d999c9f25427621a5ab&_e=mlp3USE1wOhrcEdm3fKik_EVvNjw6_IsE0_9EENeaw3gk3Z32J3xijwsw9sszqx0LTQ_CxVGi0dd6nj291i_0_iAZCqAchXLSA0chvKrojwilxacQQfBVrYe3eieHsy106aUpaHSU5NWj9MAbBtz_1Ol28xy839PjnZgx7HVdfEZAOjm-v6evTJztzbiNbCBqdIqNRxPGdUZOVGCS1uyGIgVPAoEjMzHlRtZQxSFNJl0MKNGVIxsIZWQ-Fscz9YDcLBVGN4A4_aNbGXZ_vxC9T8MBhzex2u1qC8_p86dEWSfrmnXH7nRpMkbJuUovfZQFfIz9vfRPEPDyWYP-jPFzg%3D%3D) As a border district, my community feels the pain of Biden's failed open border policies every day. I'm grateful to President Trump for the work he's already done to secure our border, and I'm hopeful to win my election in 2026 so I can FIGHT, FIGHT, FIGHT alongside him.

[](http://links.tubervilleforalabama.com/u/click?_t=b8b4efbe79f64b579dfa7d8da685a7a9&_m=99a767476ec44d999c9f25427621a5ab&_e=mlp3USE1wOhrcEdm3fKik_EVvNjw6_IsE0_9EENeaw3gk3Z32J3xijwsw9sszqx0LTQ_CxVGi0dd6nj291i_0_iAZCqAchXLSA0chvKrojwilxacQQfBVrYe3eieHsy106aUpaHSU5NWj9MAbBtz_1Ol28xy839PjnZgx7HVdfEZAOjm-v6evTJztzbiNbCBvbD9VgHH7qph-7s0IvZJ1Bg1sX7qNJQb_vwpvENY6Bi1YR15U_JI_sbxuLhuyeuARpOtA6QxE6gw-fbZk-pvIz1vNlKqHOBhYTEPNgQyHpQfESDN5S-XYrkhDlOOcokgXc9TLTf9-2Zj-GkOIW1XaQ%3D%3D)
**But as you know, California is DEEPLY blue.** _Nancy Pelosi, Gavin Newsom, and Adam Schiff have deep roots in our state 's politics, and they'll do anything to prevent a Hispanic Marine Corps Veteran from going to Congress, all because I'm a proud Republican._

**They have millions and millions of dollars already built up, ready to spend to keep California blue.** But my neighbors and I know their leadership has FAILED Californians and Americans.

[**I 'm humbly asking you to send my campaign a donation of whatever you can afford.**](http://links.tubervilleforalabama.com/u/click?_t=b8b4efbe79f64b579dfa7d8da685a7a9&_m=99a767476ec44d999c9f25427621a5ab&_e=mlp3USE1wOhrcEdm3fKik_EVvNjw6_IsE0_9EENeaw3gk3Z32J3xijwsw9sszqx0LTQ_CxVGi0dd6nj291i_0_iAZCqAchXLSA0chvKrojwilxacQQfBVrYe3eieHsy106aUpaHSU5NWj9MAbBtz_1Ol28xy839PjnZgx7HVdfEZAOjm-v6evTJztzbiNbCBwp--WE8-bt8ZFguCHFvNL9laLj7JlKKndiNxRBOmsMlVY8BnafARozeJxi0lhmd615MrOYj5R2s8stV5h11jceYJwkqHc8IgiQj5CPgID6Ou3Z03pTx1leu_zTmEIx84ERFyEUdbob7zWBD6KuIiCw%3D%3D) I vow to make your donation count and to help President Trump usher in the Golden Age of America. My district is WINNABLE, despite what the Legacy Media and Democrats will have you believe.

The only way I can win is with a strong grassroots effort. [**Peter, will you join my team so I can honor my son and give his children a better tomorrow?**](http://links.tubervilleforalabama.com/u/click?_t=b8b4efbe79f64b579dfa7d8da685a7a9&_m=99a767476ec44d999c9f25427621a5ab&_e=mlp3USE1wOhrcEdm3fKik_EVvNjw6_IsE0_9EENeaw3gk3Z32J3xijwsw9sszqx0LTQ_CxVGi0dd6nj291i_0_iAZCqAchXLSA0chvKrojwilxacQQfBVrYe3eieHsy106aUpaHSU5NWj9MAbBtz_1Ol28xy839PjnZgx7HVdfEZAOjm-v6evTJztzbiNbCBXqDOtUtjl-KEIyRA4r35rn3Z0fiG91VeDS096ARsPUl40Re1b9M9XwcCvVMlGjm6yZXV4Obq2YyKwstzmErb5lEGJxAThrrp4khLjYdx2LkbjyIn_lH3jOT7_QcnKmhvUMFFRCqvvSinZ0nhvVb8MA%3D%3D)

Thank you,
Joe Males

| [](http://links.tubervilleforalabama.com/u/click?_t=b8b4efbe79f64b579dfa7d8da685a7a9&_m=99a767476ec44d999c9f25427621a5ab&_e=mlp3USE1wOhrcEdm3fKik_EVvNjw6_IsE0_9EENeaw3gk3Z32J3xijwsw9sszqx0LTQ_CxVGi0dd6nj291i_0_iAZCqAchXLSA0chvKrojwilxacQQfBVrYe3eieHsy106aUpaHSU5NWj9MAbBtz_1Ol28xy839PjnZgx7HVdfEZAOjm-v6evTJztzbiNbCBk4CYr_o95qDRFXw36Ax1FWcjE-QIIrQq-Ld3p8Bu1IsiM37wSdeDfelKsPPVnW2YSi0sgeeeUszDrse5volYjEA3W5TYawFRnRoOuN-liwrsVEqEIwxNWVcBBw2BpWpE9S2vilrKlO-VfTrP5zbtUA%3D%3D)

Meet Joe Males:

**Joe Males is a Marine Veteran, small business-owner, city council member, and most importantly, a father. Throughout his life, he has put service to his community at the forefront of his life 's mission.

Shortly after turning 18, Joe enlisted in the Marine Corps. He attended boot camp in Camp Pendleton and later served overseas in the Philippines and Guam. After being discharged as a Sergeant, Joe remained committed to supporting his fellow veterans. He took on leadership roles in his local Elks Lodge and American Legion post, working to ensure veterans in the community had the resources and support they deserved.

Following his time in the Marine Corps, Joe carried his strong work ethic and discipline into the field of computer networking services. He started in an entry-level position, worked his way through multiple leadership roles, and in 1996, he built his own business from the ground up. Joe knows firsthand the hard work and sacrifice of this journey, and he's determined to make it easier for hardworking Americans to do the same.

Joe's entry into politics was deeply personal. After his son, a Marine who followed in his footsteps, was tragically murdered back home, Joe vowed that no parent should have to endure such a loss. Determined to take a stand for public safety and the rule of law, he ran for Hemet City Council to help ensure no other family would experience the same tragedy.

During his tenure on the City Council, Joe has led numerous initiatives to improve infrastructure, drive business growth, and keep neighborhoods safe and clean. He takes pride in his ability to collaborate with fellow council members and get results, even when facing different perspectives. Joe is committed to bringing this same results-driven approach to Washington D.C., to ensure the voices of the American people are heard and their needs are met.

name: Bryan
subject: 208 Democrats Vote Against SAVE Act
body:
Yesterday, 208 Democrats voted against common-sense legislation that would prohibit non-citizens from voting and strengthen voter ID laws

| | | | | [](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=1bd00b9f75&e=e907534017)
---
| | | | | **April 11, 2025**
---
| | | | | _**I believe that only U.S. citizens should vote in U.S elections, but Democrats in Congress decided they disagree.**_
---
[](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=ba71814721&e=e907534017)
| Yesterday, the House of Representatives scored a major win for election integrity by passing the **SAVE Act.**
The SAVE Act is a simple but powerful piece of legislation: it ensures that only American Citizens can vote in American elections by requiring **proof of citizenship** to vote and ensuring strong **voter ID** standards nationwide. That’s it.
We know that noncitizen voting is an issue, Democrats have even [admitted](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=27d4a9b2b2&e=e907534017) as much.
_**Ensuring that only citizens vote in U.S. elections shouldn’t be controversial, yet Democrats and the Left are terrified that we want to protect the integrity of our elections - why?**_
---
[](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=9e24bf1262&e=e907534017)
| It’s common sense that if you have to show an ID to drive, fly, or buy a beer you should have to show an ID and proof of citizenship to vote.
I’m proud to have championed the SAVE Act, but our work is not done. We must continue to do everything we can to ensure our elections are safe, secure, and fair.
---

[_**Can I count on your support by donating $5, $10, or even $25 today?**_](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=57ab22652c&e=e907534017)

matter.

plea for Russian help hacking Hilary Clinton’s emails in 2016 (they did).

(impeached again).

Derek, we need
to be ready for any attempt by Trump to hold power again when his
nightmare term is over.

I will continue to use my platform in the United States Senate to hold

We are living through a moment of both dread and possibility. The tides of authoritarianism are rising. Fascist movements are gaining ground. People are being targeted for how they speak, what they believe, and where they were born. The language of "invasion" and "purity" is echoing once again through halls of power and across headlines--and it's dangerous.
But if we stop there, we miss something equally true: **there is also a great convergence happening.** Amid the breakdown of the old world, a new reality is quietly being seeded--by those who have carried it across borders, through storms, and under threat. And it is time to tell the truth about that reality, not in the language of defense, but of power and promise.
* * *
### **History Tells a Different Story**
The American story has always been an immigrant story. The Pilgrims were immigrants--arriving with dreams of freedom, even as they participated in the violent colonization of Indigenous lands. (That tension--between seeking refuge and enacting harm--runs deep in our history, and it must be acknowledged as we chart a new way forward.) The Irish who fled famine, the Jews who fled pogroms, the Vietnamese who fled war--all came not just with empty hands, but with **skills, memory, and meaning**. Every major wave of immigration has immeasurably enriched this country--economically, culturally, intellectually, spiritually.
And yet, in each era, immigrants have been scapegoated--used as political pawns to stoke fear, distract from systemic failures, and consolidate power. Today's wave of ideological persecution, anti-immigrant legislation, and manufactured moral panic is not new. But it is escalating. And we must meet it not with apology and defense, but with clarity and a new narrative.
* * *
### **What If Immigrants Are Not the Problem, But the Answer?**
Let us ask a different question. What if immigrant communities are not just deserving of protection--but _essential_ to our collective future?
In a recent exploration of stateless societies like Zomia--regions where people intentionally resisted central control--we surfaced a powerful insight: **migratory communities often serve as vessels of resilience, memory, and adaptive intelligence.** When states collapse, it is often these communities--those who have already lived through displacement, repression, and reinvention--who carry memories and lessons of history, as well as the cultural and practical tools needed to rebuild.
In that light, immigrant communities in America are not a burden to be managed. On the contrary, they are **a seedbank of survival.** They preserve languages, relationships, systems of reciprocity, oral histories, ancestral trades, medicinal knowledge, cross-cultural competence, and spiritual traditions that were never captured by empire but that may prove indispensable in what comes next.
* * *
### **The Quiet Power of Immigrant Communities**
Immigrants are:
* The farmers who remember how to grow food without chemical inputs.
* The caregivers who treat the elderly not as a liability but as lineage.
* The multilingual children who code-switch between systems, carrying the capacity to bridge worlds.
* The survivors of wars, tyranny, and oppression who have already built new lives in foreign soil--and know how to do it again.

These people, beloved people, are not liabilities. They are assets--**the raw materials of regeneration.**
Immigrant communities don't just integrate. **They cross-pollinate.** They bring the seeds of other civilizations, other ways of knowing and being, and they blend them into new growth. They adapt with extraordinary resilience, often creating pockets of innovation, beauty, and solidarity in the margins of empire.
And yet, the dominant narrative sees them as "problems to solve."
That is not just inaccurate--it is dangerous.
* * *
### **Reframing the Future**
To meet this moment, we must do more than resist persecution. We must recognize and elevate immigrant communities as **repositories of collective intelligence** --as central to the American future, not peripheral to it.
We are in the early stages of a civilization-wide transition. Climate migration will increase. Economic dislocation will grow. Our political systems may fracture much further before they stabilize. The question is: **who holds the wisdom for navigating change, uncertainty, and rebirth?**
Immigrant communities do.
Their presence is not a threat--it is **a gift.** A lifeline. A roadmap. A saving grace.
It's time we stop asking how to absorb them--and start asking how to **learn from them, build with them, and support their leadership in designing what comes next.**
* * *
**This is the American Party I am building.** One that names and nourishes the seed-wealth of our communities. One that makes party politics obsolete by growing governance from the ground up. One that refuses to scapegoat the very people most essential to our survival.
If you see yourself in this vision--immigrant or not--join us.
We have work to do. And we're not doing it alone.

In a time of political violence and fear, we must reclaim the true story of who immigrants are--and what we bring. | | | Apr 11 | | | | | | | | | | | | We are living through a moment of both dread and possibility. The tides of authoritarianism are rising. Fascist movements are gaining ground. People are being targeted for how they speak, what they believe, and where they were born. The language of "invasion" and "purity" is echoing once again through halls of power and across headlines--and it's dangerous. But if we stop there, we miss something equally true: there is also a great convergence happening. Amid the breakdown of the old world, a new reality is quietly being seeded--by those who have carried it across borders, through storms, and under threat. And it is time to tell the truth about that reality, not in the language of defense, but of power and promise. History Tells a Different Story The American story has always been an immigrant story. The Pilgrims were immigrants--arriving with dreams of freedom, even as they participated in the violent colonization of Indigenous lands. (That tension--between seeking refuge and enacting harm--runs deep in our history, and it must be acknowledged as we chart a new way forward.) The Irish who fled famine, the Jews who fled pogroms, the Vietnamese who fled war--all came not just with empty hands, but with skills, memory, and meaning. Every major wave of immigration has immeasurably enriched this country--economically, culturally, intellectually, spiritually. And yet, in each era, immigrants have been scapegoated--used as political pawns to stoke fear, distract from systemic failures, and consolidate power. Today's wave of ideological persecution, anti-immigrant legislation, and manufactured moral panic is not new. But it is escalating. And we must meet it not with apology and defense, but with clarity and a new narrative. What If Immigrants Are Not the Problem, But the Answer? Let us ask a different question. What if immigrant communities are not just deserving of protection--but essential to our collective future? In a recent exploration of stateless societies like Zomia--regions where people intentionally resisted central control--we surfaced a powerful insight: migratory communities often serve as vessels of resilience, memory, and adaptive intelligence. When states collapse, it is often these communities--those who have already lived through displacement, repression, and reinvention--who carry memories and lessons of history, as well as the cultural and practical tools needed to rebuild. In that light, immigrant communities in America are not a burden to be managed. On the contrary, they are a seedbank of survival. They preserve languages, relationships, systems of reciprocity, oral histories, ancestral trades, medicinal knowledge, cross-cultural competence, and spiritual traditions that were never captured by empire but that may prove indispensable in what comes next. The Quiet Power of Immigrant Communities Immigrants are: The farmers who remember how to grow food without chemical inputs. The caregivers who treat the elderly not as a liability but as lineage. The multilingual children who code-switch between systems, carrying the capacity to bridge worlds. The survivors of wars, tyranny, and oppression who have already built new lives in foreign soil--and know how to do it again. These people, beloved people, are not liabilities. They are assets--the raw materials of regeneration. Immigrant communities don't just integrate. They cross-pollinate. They bring the seeds of other civilizations, other ways of knowing and being, and they blend them into new growth. They adapt with extraordinary resilience, often creating pockets of innovation, beauty, and solidarity in the margins of empire. And yet, the dominant narrative sees them as "problems to solve." That is not just inaccurate--it is dangerous. Reframing the Future To meet this moment, we must do more than resist persecution. We must recognize and elevate immigrant communities as repositories of collective intelligence --as central to the American future, not peripheral to it. We are in the early stages of a civilization-wide transition. Climate migration will increase. Economic dislocation will grow. Our political systems may fracture much further before they stabilize. The question is: who holds the wisdom for navigating change, uncertainty, and rebirth? Immigrant communities do. Their presence is not a threat--it is a gift. A lifeline. A roadmap. A saving grace. It's time we stop asking how to absorb them--and start asking how to learn from them, build with them, and support their leadership in designing what comes next. This is the American Party I am building.** One that names and nourishes the seed-wealth of our communities. One that makes party politics obsolete by growing governance from the ground up. One that refuses to scapegoat the very people most essential to our survival. If you see yourself in this vision--immigrant or not--join us. We have work to do. And we're not doing it alone. **I’m running to make Michigan the best place to be a kid, raise a kid, and call home — and I’m ready for this work.**
Growing up, my parents taught me that we have a responsibility to make sure that everyone gets a fair shot in life. That’s why I ran for Secretary of State — to ensure that our government is efficient, transparent, and works for everyone.

**But there’s still a lot of work to be done to ensure that every Michigander has the opportunity to provide for themselves and their families.**
That’s why I’m running for Governor — to fight for higher wages and lower costs, give every child a strong education, protect our rights and freedoms, make our communities safer, and make sure that every Michigander gets that fair shot in life.

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_jones_em_q22025? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_jones_em_q22025?]
Did you catch this, team? I've officially filed the paperwork to run for Virginia Attorney General! 🎉
I’m running because we need an Attorney General focused on keeping Virginians safe, not a personal, partisan political agenda. If you're already fired up to support my campaign to retire Virginia’s MAGA Attorney General, please make a special contribution right now to help me launch the next phase of my campaign. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_jones_em_q22025?]
DONATE $25 NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_jones_em_q22025?amount=25]
I am the descendant of slaves. My grandfather, a Civil Rights attorney, was one of the first Black lawyers in Virginia. My father was in the first wave of students to integrate Norfolk’s classrooms, even as the Attorney General at that time shut down the schools to stop it.
Right now, we face an uncertain future, with a President who openly flouts the rule of law. In times like these, I draw strength from my ancestors. In the very darkest days of our history, when things looked far more grim than they do today, they held unswervingly to hope that a brighter future was possible.
That’s why I’m in this race – because I know a brighter future for Virginia is possible.
I am so grateful to everyone who has joined my team, met us out on the campaign trail, shared our vision for Virginia, and pitched in to help. We wouldn’t have made it this far without your support.
I know you’re ready to fight for Virginia families, to fight back against MAGA politics in Virginia and protect abortion rights, so I need you with me today.
I have set a goal of earning the support of 1,000 grassroots donors to help launch the next phase of my campaign – now that I am officially on the ballot! I’m counting on folks like you, team, to help me reach this ambitious goal and power this campaign. Will you chip in any amount right now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/loc_jones_em_q22025?]

subject: Our New Mission.

body:
[https://secure.winred.com/john-james-for-mi/announcement-wama?utm_source=prospecting&utm_term=WAMA_email&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=JAMES_ANNOUNCEMENT_WAMA&recurring=true&utm_term=lrm-active]

Co-Pilot -

_OUR MISSION TO DEFEND MICHIGAN HAS A __MAJOR DEVELOPMENT. _

I’m announcing MY INTENTION TO RUN FOR GOVERNOR AT ONE OF THE MOST
CRITICAL POINTS IN OUR NATION’S HISTORY.

Under Joe Biden and Gretchen Whitmer, our economy, our industry, and
our people have all suffered.

Michiganders were fed up with the status-quo bureaucracy, and that’s
why our state turned RED in 2024.

I stood alongside President Trump on the campaign trail and spoke with
him at rallies where we shared our vision for America.

Our movement for strong, America First policies has gained momentum,
and we need to carry it through to the midterms to ensure that
Michigan can get back on track.

_OUR MISSION_

The first step towards fixing our state and our nation occurred on
November 5th of last year when we elected President Trump, but the
truth is, we still have work to do.

We have 2 more years of Democrat obstruction and failed economic
policies to endure in Michigan. That’s why it’s of vital
importance to prepare NOW.

OUR MISSION IS TWOFOLD:

1. We are working _TO MAKE LIFE EASIER AND MORE PROSPEROUS FOR
MICHIGANDERS_ - no matter what political party they are in - through
pro-business, pro-growth and PRO-WORKER America First policies.

2. We are working to PREVENT another 4 years of the same socialist
policies that have hurt our state.

NEITHER OF THESE OBJECTIVES CAN BE COMPLETED ALONE. THAT’S WHY
I’LL NEED YOUR SUPPORT. But, before I ask you to join us, I want you
to know my story.

_MY STORY_

You’re going to hear a lot about me from the mainstream media over
the coming months. I’m ready for the mud-slinging from the Democrat
establishment, but I want to tell you who I am:

- First and foremost, I am a GOD-LOVING HUSBAND AND FATHER OF THREE
BOYS.

- I am a WEST POINT GRADUATE AND A COMBAT VETERAN who commanded 2
Apache Helicopter platoons – logging over 750 flight hours to
protect our freedom and defend the American Dream.

- I am the proud SON OF TWO PARENTS WHO WERE BORN AND RAISED IN THE
JIM CROW SOUTH. They moved to Michigan, built a business, and watched
as their son was sworn into the U.S. House of Representatives.

- I AM A BUSINESSMAN with a background in the automotive and
manufacturing sector. I understand how our economy works, how red tape
and bureaucracy weighs down innovation and progress, and the
tremendous responsibility that comes with being a job creator.

- I am a PUBLIC SERVANT WHO REPRESENTS THE PEOPLE OF MICHIGAN’S 10TH
CONGRESSIONAL DISTRICT and fights for them every day in Washington,
DC.

- I am a CONSERVATIVE WARRIOR WHO HAS GONE TOE-TO-TOE WITH THE
DEMOCRAT ESTABLISHMENT MACHINE time and time again.

I am PREPARED TO LEAD OUR MISSION to make Michigan the best place to
live in the nation once more.

But don’t let anyone tell you that this is going to be easy.

JOIN OUR MISSION
[https://secure.winred.com/john-james-for-mi/announcement-wama?utm_source=prospecting&utm_term=WAMA_email&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=JAMES_ANNOUNCEMENT_WAMA&recurring=true&utm_term=lrm-active]

[https://secure.winred.com/john-james-for-mi/announcement-wama?utm_source=prospecting&utm_term=WAMA_email&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=JAMES_ANNOUNCEMENT_WAMA&recurring=true&utm_term=lrm-active]

_THE ROAD AHEAD_

- Michigan will be the MOST COMPETITIVE SWING STATE IN THE NATION.
With open Gubernatorial and Senate seats on the ballot, all eyes will
be laser focused on our campaign.

- Democrats have controlled Lansing for over 6 years now. Their
POLITICAL AND FINANCIAL MACHINE IS ENTRENCHED and ready to attack any
person who tries to challenge them.

- MIDTERMS ARE NOTORIOUSLY DIFFICULT FOR THE PARTY IN POWER
NATIONALLY. We are going to have to work twice as hard to share our
message of economic prosperity and America First policies.

- This race will be on the TOP OF THE LIST FOR EVERY SINGLE DEMOCRAT
DARK MONEY SUPERPAC.

For all of those reasons, this fight cannot be won alone.

_WHY I NEED YOU ON MY TEAM_

I need the support of patriots like you to have a chance to win this
battle.

I know the challenges ahead and I’m choosing to fight anyway.

_NOW THAT YOU KNOW THE STAKES, ARE YOU WILLING TO CONTINUE ON THIS
MISSION WITH ME AS MY CO-PILOT? _
[https://secure.winred.com/john-james-for-mi/announcement-wama?utm_source=prospecting&utm_term=WAMA_email&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=JAMES_ANNOUNCEMENT_WAMA&recurring=true&utm_term=lrm-active]

IF YOU’RE IN, I HUMBLY ASK THAT YOU SIGN YOUR NAME TO BECOME A
FOUNDING SUPPORTER OF MY RACE.

BECOME MY FOUNDING CO-PILOT
[https://secure.winred.com/john-james-for-mi/announcement-wama?utm_source=prospecting&utm_term=WAMA_email&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=JAMES_ANNOUNCEMENT_WAMA&recurring=true&utm_term=lrm-active]

SUPPORT JOHN JAMES
[https://secure.winred.com/john-james-for-mi/announcement-wama?utm_source=prospecting&utm_term=WAMA_email&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=JAMES_ANNOUNCEMENT_WAMA&recurring=true&utm_term=lrm-active]

Let’s Fly!

John James

“Move fast, break things” is a motto used a lot in the tech sector.
The idea is simple: prioritize speed over perfection. Get your product out quickly. If something breaks along the way, fix it later. The goal is rapid innovation, not careful planning.
That mindset may work great for Silicon Valley, but it costs lives when we’re talking about cuts to cancer research, VA health care and the suicide hotline, Medicare, and Social Security.
The bottom line is that Elon Musk’s DOGE is stealing from the American people to pay for tax breaks for billionaires like him, and circumventing Congress and the Constitution in the process.
I introduced the Delete DOGE Act to stop what he’s doing and prevent him from robbing the American people and our future even more — because I refuse to stand by and watch an irresponsible billionaire tech bro play games with people’s lives and livelihoods.
I’m committed to fighting as hard as I can to protect critical government services that so many people rely on, but I need your support:
Will you sign on to my petition to pass the Delete DOGE Act to show that there’s strong public support for this legislation? [https://secure.ngpvan.com/00dtxe9fh02NfMwxIiwG5A2]
Thank you so much — I’ll keep you posted on what’s next.
-Sara

Friend, Even without an act of Congress, attacks on our earned Social Security benefits are well underway. Elon Musk’s DOGE is cutting thousands of staff from the Social Security Administration, putting up barriers between us and our earned benefits, including phone wait times doubling, the Social Security web portal repeatedly crashing, and offices closing. Musk, the richest man in the world, is falsely claiming rampant fraud in Social Security, because he doesn’t understand how the system works and because he wants to steal from everyday people. Trump has repeated Musk’s lies, including in his address before a joint session of Congress. They are laying the groundwork for Social Security’s collapse, with Trump’s Commerce Secretary (another billionaire) even saying last month that if Social Security checks don’t go out, anyone who complains is a fraudster.1 They’re destroying Social Security before our very eyes. We must defend this lifesaving program, which lifts 27 million Americans out of poverty each year. **[Add your name now to demand Congress act to protect Social Security from Trump and his billionaire cronies. Demand Donald Trump and Elon Musk get their hands off Social Security!](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3_fE85A4xWSon0q-5B4ZQMVgk09iuTATutqJbz5vTqWNau3r7XRaUM93zis_Vf0QB7iH_7GANZpe5F_m2yGuLgtMBHgpEw1zym8LC1AYc9Xdcvr1_NFe0rrRbi9zvmSq40AT0_puANSGdReJ4t_BgNKdXRKTZNo5RjBk5rnRzfhAwwmkWOWapbEr1iqCNRNgvj6hUFl9y01lT1WTC1MprfdCCP2HuuJQ6WHDRc-9QlBCjiPO-ZhOZOobrzxfCG9BbRruZrygabtAuv6ICo6E59JWEZ61iwWOzTt5h_OOZXhPtovivG5NWCPme7Ci83FkNqdnNgHbEyGDFX2ck4HvhXfiAnK6kKleCm1bi6-yLysdOqqnnvXPQt29caRRUxNrk90MuKjFo1MI5pkLnamAQ_n/4fk/f-WhoAy5Q5eagl4v-pig8g/h1/h001.YZiHDrNYJvkGqLemGkbUcII7Xq-U0Qqz0k_LAedZaY8)** [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3_fE85A4xWSon0q-5B4ZQMVgk09iuTATutqJbz5vTqWNQSnGzQe794UsnfKrI4W3hZUvHvLx1pRAZItRV2f-cM49E_cIuZdeVHiyMpYENz7mrSzU_Uly_yTg5T2kiPmPFIo1zMU7-rQ6KfRriniT4tWG-3K0OnmGqzYE3hDO1r4kg_J18OBoxDdZ9mb1isAbZ7y0fc7wWY4KD62z-g3Detdb4YEgvWmPHQRaA0NgRQHPqE66KgBhQ5bq_ZoGsVzSHW3j2iUQtMk6BwmMgRf_wJA7xpl1SWDB_V0txGcNKdUop4m2evrdlRfu12Vwn2ScnNq17Ksq5Jou1vWZZ2Q0pK1DnvaddpPVoR7UGGsa_rP1ZZK0HGdQbe13T0GPu8xgIPXRoInRxMxeAIv9i3u_luB/4fk/f-WhoAy5Q5eagl4v-pig8g/h2/h001.8o3wag2EsK4DPRuimvYlLOIY_VXZ1SDOAQ6wgF0OpwM) | [TAKE ACTION](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3_fE85A4xWSon0q-5B4ZQMVgk09iuTATutqJbz5vTqWNYE6ohe6r-AuP71BgYzQ9AUT-e_-6gVlM_7TRgI9ZIanMnrWWYqowuHML7RDYdJ8_QMDkmGaLeKr0wZ2k_WgPgmh1_P427R-NUv7zrz47bleja1fGpjqe8FkDwukAfLYYPd-H4FaXW9sAFWOSQyArCvyn0tCSquXWyAJbVFAC1D3Tcc1N7tidwt2ANEzO_trzx_Jzt4qi8Y8mvk1nphbq4qTkcPnfhi8BMOHtS8ctyTiaDBvCvfTVpSheMCe5zwMQO--3z1J7kl1Y2ImaQxaCS3nemAKpuZ8tFKj6ybZuRnhIrgBBhFuBf5MFFl0a1ehfrKrD0vhn_vjZ_koM9SLxO0yH2dFy1mtGNfieviDRpKK/4fk/f-WhoAy5Q5eagl4v-pig8g/h3/h001.up0F06oL0QtPVFIX1hUk6e0oMM6dUmCOl3MydI6ulKQ)

Upon implementation of Social Security 85 years ago, FDR said, “no damn politician can ever scrap my social security program.”2 Unfortunately, FDR didn’t account for the billionaire dismantling of our federal government. Musk is by far the richest person in the world, and he wants seniors and people with disabilities to starve. We won't let that happen.
Together, we must never give up in our defense of our rights, our earned benefits, and our very democracy. We will keep pushing for a government that provides for people’s needs, not the profits of billionaires.
With you in this fight,
Rashida

Republicans and their Wall Street donors have been seeking to dismantle and privatize Social Security since its inception 85 years ago. They want to get their hands on our hard-earned benefits and gamble our retirement security on the stock market.
Because we have successfully beaten back their repeated attempts to cut or undermine Social Security in Congress, now they are dismantling Social Security in a new way: through Elon Musk’s so-called “Department of Government Efficiency” (DOGE).
**Already, thousands of workers at the Social Security Administration (SSA) have been fired or forced out** , with Musk claiming that thousands more will lose their jobs. **A new report from Senator Bernie Sanders indicates that if Elon Musk and Donald Trump successfully gut the Social Security Administration, 67,000 people could die while awaiting approval of their disability benefits.** 1
The last Social Security Commissioner, Martin O’Malley, stated that Musk’s actions, which include gaining access to people’s sensitive Social Security information, will lead to a “system collapse” within the “next 30 to 90 days.”2

clean_body: Already, thousands of workers at the Social Security Administration (SSA) have been fired or forced out. | | | Friend, Even without an act of Congress, attacks on our earned Social Security benefits are well underway. Elon Musk’s DOGE is cutting thousands of staff from the Social Security Administration, putting up barriers between us and our earned benefits, including phone wait times doubling, the Social Security web portal repeatedly crashing, and offices closing. Musk, the richest man in the world, is falsely claiming rampant fraud in Social Security, because he doesn’t understand how the system works and because he wants to steal from everyday people. Trump has repeated Musk’s lies, including in his address before a joint session of Congress. They are laying the groundwork for Social Security’s collapse, with Trump’s Commerce Secretary (another billionaire) even saying last month that if Social Security checks don’t go out, anyone who complains is a fraudster.1 They’re destroying Social Security before our very eyes. We must defend this lifesaving program, which lifts 27 million Americans out of poverty each year. | Upon implementation of Social Security 85 years ago, FDR said, “no damn politician can ever scrap my social security program.”2 Unfortunately, FDR didn’t account for the billionaire dismantling of our federal government. Musk is by far the richest person in the world, and he wants seniors and people with disabilities to starve. We won't let that happen. Together, we must never give up in our defense of our rights, our earned benefits, and our very democracy. We will keep pushing for a government that provides for people’s needs, not the profits of billionaires. With you in this fight, Rashida 1 2 \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Rashida Tlaib** Date: Thu, April 10, 2025 Subject: Demand Congress protect Social Security from Elon Musk and Donald Trump To: dpwillis67@gmail.com Friend, Republicans and their Wall Street donors have been seeking to dismantle and privatize Social Security since its inception 85 years ago. They want to get their hands on our hard-earned benefits and gamble our retirement security on the stock market. Because we have successfully beaten back their repeated attempts to cut or undermine Social Security in Congress, now they are dismantling Social Security in a new way: through Elon Musk’s so-called “Department of Government Efficiency” (DOGE). Already, thousands of workers at the Social Security Administration (SSA) have been fired or forced out , with Musk claiming that thousands more will lose their jobs. This is leading to the closure of Social Security field offices, call wait times stretching hours on end, and the time it takes to process disability claims likely to stretch well beyond a year. A new report from Senator Bernie Sanders indicates that if Elon Musk and Donald Trump successfully gut the Social Security Administration, 67,000 people could die while awaiting approval of their disability benefits. 1 The last Social Security Commissioner, Martin O’Malley, stated that Musk’s actions, which include gaining access to people’s sensitive Social Security information, will lead to a “system collapse” within the “next 30 to 90 days.”2 Last Saturday, millions of people made our voices heard at Hands Off! rallies and protests in towns and cities across the country. We demanded Trump and Musk get their hands off Social Security, Medicare, Medicaid, veterans’ benefits, nutrition benefits, public education, voting rights, and our very democracy. We won't let billionaires steal from seniors and people with disabilities. I joined the workers’ union that represents workers at the Social Security Administration―American Federation of Government Employees (AFGE)―at a rally in Michigan last Friday to defend SSA and federal workers. Right now, more than 4 million Americans turn 65 each year. We need to be ensuring access to our lifesaving earned Social Security benefits, not putting up barriers between us and the benefits that we’ve paid into over a lifetime of work. Social Security lifts 27 million Americans out of poverty each year. It is the most beloved social insurance program in our country’s history. We will not let billionaires dismantle it and hand our hard-earned benefits over to Wall Street. body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Donald Trump and unelected billionaire Elon Musk have spent months
slashing federal funding to the bone, laying off countless workers, and
gutting social safety net programs that working class people depend on.

Meanwhile, Trump and his Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth just announced
their plans for a $1 trillion Pentagon budget — while still terminating
tens of thousands of civilian jobs within the Defense Department.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250411?refcode=em20250411-36577&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36577_1203867_QmePh7&akid=36577%2E1203867%2EQmePh7 ]Headline reads "Trump, Hegseth promise record $1 trillion Pentagon
budget". Subhead reads "The surprise announcement comes as the Defense
Department prepares to lay off thousands of civilians."

This is DOGE in a nutshell: taking the largest federal agency budget —
which has NEVER passed an audit — and making it even bigger while still
somehow cutting thousands of jobs. There’s somehow always money for
endless war, but never for things that would improve everyday people’s
lives, like Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, or free college education.

On top of that, SpaceX just secured yet another giant government contract
through the Pentagon. Cuts for thee, not for me, huh Elon?

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250411?refcode=em20250411-36577&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36577_1203867_QmePh7&akid=36577%2E1203867%2EQmePh7 ]Image of Tweet from Robert Reich which reads "SpaceX just landed a
$5.92B contract with the Pentagon for Space Force rocket launches - the
largest contract among three firms who secured deals to send satellites

With only two states having Governors races this year, all eyes are on Jersey to see if we’ll stand up for our Jersey Values, or cave to the far-right agenda.

As the “Lower Taxes, Lower Costs” Governor, I will fight tooth and nail to deliver results, solve problems, and get things done for the people of our state, all while protecting our Jersey Values.

That means fighting for programs that are on the chopping block. But I can’t do it alone.

**[Anything you can pitch in will help me stay in this fight.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/105656949/538964265/-486314421?amount=10&source=EM_NBI_JG_20250411_FR_SocialSecurity_0_3MO_JoshGottheimer_NA_NA_NA&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDczNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4M2Y2Y2RlYS1mMTE2LWYwMTEtOGIzZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BiipppE_JPS39y3_x13fqZvXyNhJj4OCg8NiLzqhU60=&emci=6bf6cdea-f116-f011-8b3d-0022482a9fb7&emdi=83f6cdea-f116-f011-8b3d-0022482a9fb7&ceid=37438246)**

Thank you,

Josh
|
* * *

My fellow Americans - it is Vice President JD Vance.

_**[This is a longer email but I respectfully ask you to read it from start to finish.](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=480750084f5f49ce8766733909545468&_e=LXgcfy4PaSWElz1E6cPuwAnJ4o3lcPvcTZKt0INPFtjqToCFSQJUiDIwE-utq2g3uNLzkOvkpHE_7NUu_pEyPMtdFDJOlpKk8Aes_TWSfu3F-a3N3XsWoNg3ynxiK2U4aI7hC4UYE6FuqLTyx9Nk1tJdA-7ob0fbxZ3bhQ3KJ9CQUHgpMLcEKSPjHqNFCGM-v9_BujNFK-mjlew4KYTzK0RlM5dXzQptd9StSVxOt5flfmAYHSFi92EIb1DayPTVOZwN4GqfnHLU5zMPPi81q3WMmZOr7-CaDwrrCpZBoIJCryOf388f_gczvaSsAhEFpchS7sYGGCYUymfx4a7IGUL_tjGuWpl4XFi197Py_upembjbKlgYQNA5TMvyQVmqbj070l2nf7VcLhcRZONAEg%3D%3D "This is a longer email but I respectfully ask you to read it from start to finish.")**_

It wasn't easy telling the world I grew up poor, raised by my Mamaw while my mother struggled with addiction.

It wasn't exactly the prep school/trust fund/summer-in-the-Hamptons upbringing that is commonplace in DC.

**But I felt called to tell my story. Warts and all.** I felt led to speak out because I think millions of Americans share stories like mine. Stories of jobs being outsourced to China, addiction ravaging communities and killing our neighbors, and heeding the call of duty after the Towers fell on 9/11.

_As your Vice President, I now stand in the breach for the left-behind, forgotten men and women who built this country, but were abandoned by the political class in DC. _

I'll do everything in my power to make sure that never happens again. I'll fight every day for good folks like you.

I promise to always stand between you and the Democrat Machine that aims to obliterate everything that makes our country great.

_**[Which brings me to the purpose of my email today.](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=480750084f5f49ce8766733909545468&_e=LXgcfy4PaSWElz1E6cPuwAnJ4o3lcPvcTZKt0INPFtjqToCFSQJUiDIwE-utq2g3uNLzkOvkpHE_7NUu_pEyPMtdFDJOlpKk8Aes_TWSfu3F-a3N3XsWoNg3ynxiK2U4aI7hC4UYE6FuqLTyx9Nk1tJdA-7ob0fbxZ3bhQ3KJ9CQUHgpMLcEKSPjHqNFCGM-v9_BujNFK-mjlew4KYTzK0RlM5dXzQptd9StSVxOt5flfmAYHSFi92EIb1DayPTVneAmDrwPdvTK8bcghcGgvZ3KZu4NKmxLvG2q8To40vgKG1YxtRpmGW60V3Bmhz5ZsNjO1PE7gtjiPlYqo0l8wtDdDwZ7XJVHAYO2osJJCrAvFe_pHcKI5HxOz_kYVsGfww2kKWZtFYstE9vMwJXRIQ%3D%3D "Which brings me to the purpose of my email today.")**_

We're coming out of the most expensive election in American history. I mean that. Kamala Harris spent over a billion dollars against us. It took EVERY PENNY we had to get our story out there, expose her ultra-Liberal record, reach undecided voters, and win.

So now we're forced to rebuild.

The Democrat Machine is **ALREADY** crushing us in fundraising, **ALREADY** outspending us in key races, and **ALREADY** building the campaign infrastructure to decimate us in the Midterm Elections.

At this point, the consequences of simply resting on our laurels would be unthinkable.

So here's my final pitch to you:

_**[I'm teaming up with Majority Leader Steve Scalise - for the FIRST TIME since the election - to raise a million dollars by the end of the month.](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=480750084f5f49ce8766733909545468&_e=LXgcfy4PaSWElz1E6cPuwAnJ4o3lcPvcTZKt0INPFtjqToCFSQJUiDIwE-utq2g3uNLzkOvkpHE_7NUu_pEyPMtdFDJOlpKk8Aes_TWSfu3F-a3N3XsWoNg3ynxiK2U4aI7hC4UYE6FuqLTyx9Nk1tJdA-7ob0fbxZ3bhQ3KJ9CQUHgpMLcEKSPjHqNFCGM-v9_BujNFK-mjlew4KYTzK0RlM5dXzQptd9StSVxOt5flfmAYHSFi92EIb1DayPTVwVtD7zSbIPwgkOk3v80dlFVohfi61qlGYmVaRdCqFs_rYh4oBRMF2gZNLP8T-7irA9ozbKmYIJdylxmVbjIAuf76jRHJZ5TAw6KKf3yP8bWgNKiUdY_iyQ_VjU6F1S1bIFMRAlLo7Ip9xsfbpbZaDw%3D%3D "I’m teaming up with Majority Leader Steve Scalise – for the FIRST TIME since the election – to raise a million dollars by the end of the month.")**_ I understand that's ambitious. But if that's what it takes to deliver President Trump a Republican House for his entire second term, it's a no-brainer I'll do what it takes to win.

Do you think you can help us get there?

_Whether it 's $5 or $500 - the amount you give isn't nearly as important as how many folks step up:_

Vice President JD Vance

I promise to always stand between you and the Democrat Machine that aims to obliterate everything that makes our country great. "Which brings me to the purpose of my email today." We're coming out of the most expensive election in American history. I mean that. Kamala Harris spent over a billion dollars against us. It took EVERY PENNY we had to get our story out there, expose her ultra-Liberal record, reach undecided voters, and win. So now we're forced to rebuild. The Democrat Machine is ALREADY crushing us in fundraising, ALREADY outspending us in key races, and ALREADY building the campaign infrastructure to decimate us in the Midterm Elections. At this point, the consequences of simply resting on our laurels would be unthinkable. So here's my final pitch to you: "I’m teaming up with Majority Leader Steve Scalise – for the FIRST TIME since the election – to raise a million dollars by the end of the month." I understand that's ambitious. But if that's what it takes to deliver President Trump a Republican House for his entire second term, it's a no-brainer I'll do what it takes to win. Do you think you can help us get there? Whether it 's $5 or $500 - the amount you give isn't nearly as important as how many folks step up: | | | "PLEASE JOIN US" Look, you've probably heard bits and pieces of my story at this point. If my humble beginnings taught me anything, it's to never give up, never surrender, and never go down without a fight. That's why I'm partnering with Steve Scalise to help lay the critical groundwork we need to win. "I don’t ever want you to donate more than you can afford – but if you can spare ANYTHING, even a few bucks, it would be tremendously appreciated." Regardless, it's an honor to fight alongside you. ###### * From The LA Progressive
### CLIFF'S NOTE: The Day That The Don & The Dweeb Get Flayed..By Everyone
Well, praise be and pass the ketamine, because after a way-too-slow start, Democrats have shown up with a spine and a microphone this week. And they didn't tiptoe into the fight, they unleashed a full-on verbal carpet bombing of the Axis of Narcissism: [Donald Trump & Elon Musk](https://substack.com/redirect/f176a172-9f05-4e8f-be38-b5052603b2c0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). To paraphrase Matthew McConaughey' Clint, from "Dazed and Confused, they showed up to kick ass and drink beer. They seem to have run outta beer...
From Trump's toddler-with-a-credit-card understanding of tariffs--Former U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen [called Trump's tariff policy](https://substack.com/redirect/e7cb726b-202d-4220-b5c0-17a54e092f69?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) "..the worst self-inflicted wound that I have ever seen an administration impose on a well-functioning economy,"--to Elon Musk being declared "the most unlikeable person in the country" by __ Rep. Robert Garcia. It was on this week. Former Democratic officials, current ones, economists, gamers(!)...all decided that treating a couple of dough-brained dingos with even a modicum of respect was no longer warranted.
The gloves are off, and Dems are swinging like they just remembered they're in a street fight for democracy. Maxwell Frost bodied GOP lawmakers for treating Musk like the second coming of Steve Jobs, minus the competence or charisma. Gamers--yes, _gamers_ --are roasting Elon harder than a 12-year-old on Xbox Live (see image below). It's not just political now. It's cultural. _And they 're losing_.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/eb96262c-64f0-4826-acc5-460e1ba9af12?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Even the Republican church mice--who've spent the last eight years hiding behind pews labeled "concerned" & "anonymous source"--[are starting to squeak up](https://substack.com/redirect/6e089d7f-0d74-4f1f-83c1-6c0c5530a2d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). _The_ _Dispatch_ dropped an editorial that sounded like it was ghostwritten by Liz Cheney after three bourbons, warning that Trump's descent into authoritarian cosplay is a one-way ticket to American ruin.
Meanwhile, his trade rep [just got publicly pantsed on live TV](https://substack.com/redirect/ade0b236-979b-4daa-9224-a6c7dd20483e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) after unveiling new tariffs with all the strategic foresight of trying to build IKEA furniture with major head trauma and no instructions. Paul Krugman called Trump "..stupid, erratic and weak," with his tariff policy and pathetic bluster, which is economist-speak for "this guy shouldn't be allowed near a lemonade stand, let alone a national economy." It's not actually policy--it's amateur hour at the Megalomaniac Improv Club.
**Blue Amp 's a simple idea: Insiders turned fearless outsiders **_**telling you what others won 't**_**. We 're un-bought; We Need Your Support.**_**Please become a paid subscriber**_
[ Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.DOcuLZ7vi5bVPB5kMhN3bAgS2Z-dxCMvDtZWXvp6BjA?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=161096869)
The best part? This sudden Democratic messaging surge didn't just feel like a political moment--it felt like a cultural one. Democrats, Republicans, others, have been critical, but not consistently with the kind of language they're now using. Especially the more academic types like Krugman, Yellin, et al.
This feels like a long overdue reckoning. Like someone finally screamed, "Enough!" into the void and the void screamed back, "And also, Elon sucks!" The mask is slipping, the emperor has no tariffs, and finally, it seems like the people holding the mics aren't afraid to say it out loud _in the harshest of terms_. So now let's turn it up to 11.
Let's not make these attacks weekly or daily, even hourly. How about _**constant**_? It will take nothing less than that to win back our democracy, and it seems many are finally realizing that.
* * *
### _**... Yo, Check This Out!**_
* In the least surprising news you'll ever hear, category, Marjorie Taylor Greene's former hubby--the one she cheated on with the gym rat, who she then cheated on with the idiotic right-wing news personality who had the temerity to question Volodymyr Zelenskyy's Oval Office attire--is who you thought someone married to that repulsive, racist minotaur would be.
[Perry Greene was actually caught on video](https://substack.com/redirect/c7f3787c-fdef-49ce-bd1a-f66844555d85?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) mocking and yelling at women in a parking lot near Atlanta March 31st...for being Muslim. **And praying**. So, a bigot? Check. A publicly aggressive idiot? Check. Stupid enough to let video capture his actions? Also, check. Not sure why these two aren't still married. Besides, ya know, all the cheating.

Dear Peter,

This **Black Maternal Health Week (BMHW)** , we uplift the voices, stories, and lived experiences of Black Mamas and birthing people. It’s a time to celebrate, raise awareness, inspire activism, and build community in the fight for birth and reproductive justice.

The U.S. remains in a maternal health crisis and Black women continue to face the highest risks. They are nearly **three times** more likely than white women to die from pregnancy-related causes. As anti-rights forces work to dismantle access to holistic and respectful care, the work of the Black Mamas Matter Alliance (BMMA) is more essential than ever. [**Learn more about their vital work.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/105657947/538967078/170433278?sourceid=1150594&utm_campaign=25emcmu-0401aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=bmma&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NmM0YTY0ZS1mMzE2LWYwMTEtOGIzZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HxN3nh2KrivfAxAUddR9Pp1rVryHgJTCFHMcmyM5NzE=&emci=4ba3e6e9-4316-f011-8b3d-0022482a9fb7&emdi=86c4a64e-f316-f011-8b3d-0022482a9fb7&ceid=954237)

This year’s theme: **Healing Legacies: Strengthening Black Maternal Health through Collective Action and Advocacy** highlights the power of coming together to build a future rooted in equity and healing. BMMA continues to lead with innovative research, policy proposals, and educational resources that drive real change.

[**Explore the BMHW toolkit to see how you can take action this week.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/105657948/538967079/170433278?sourceid=1150594&utm_campaign=25emcmu-0401aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=bmma&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NmM0YTY0ZS1mMzE2LWYwMTEtOGIzZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HxN3nh2KrivfAxAUddR9Pp1rVryHgJTCFHMcmyM5NzE=&emci=4ba3e6e9-4316-f011-8b3d-0022482a9fb7&emdi=86c4a64e-f316-f011-8b3d-0022482a9fb7&ceid=954237) [ ](https://click.everyaction.com/k/105657949/538967080/170433278?sourceid=1150594&utm_campaign=25emcmu-0401aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=bmma&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NmM0YTY0ZS1mMzE2LWYwMTEtOGIzZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HxN3nh2KrivfAxAUddR9Pp1rVryHgJTCFHMcmyM5NzE=&emci=4ba3e6e9-4316-f011-8b3d-0022482a9fb7&emdi=86c4a64e-f316-f011-8b3d-0022482a9fb7&ceid=954237) At the Center, we’re proud to partner with BMMA. It’s a time to celebrate, raise awareness, inspire activism, and build community in the fight for birth and reproductive justice. The U.S. remains in a maternal health crisis and Black women continue to face the highest risks. They are nearly three times more likely than white women to die from pregnancy-related causes. As anti-rights forces work to dismantle access to holistic and respectful care, the work of the Black Mamas Matter Alliance (BMMA) is more essential than ever. This year’s theme: Healing Legacies: Strengthening Black Maternal Health through Collective Action and Advocacy highlights the power of coming together to build a future rooted in equity and healing. BMMA continues to lead with innovative research, policy proposals, and educational resources that drive real change. At the Center, we’re proud to partner with BMMA. Through our Maternal Health & Rights Initiative, we’re fighting to remove legal barriers to midwifery care, expand access to high-quality maternity care, and address pervasive racism in the health care system. Black Mamas have always been at the forefront of movements for justice, bridging families, communities, and change.
